items.title_zh: 深蓝汽车官宣合作豆包大模型，全新深蓝S07首发搭载，9月28日上市
items.title_en: Deepal Announces Partnership with Doubao LLM; New Deepal S07 to Debut the Tech, Launching September 28
items.summary_zh: 深蓝汽车官宣合作豆包大模型，全新深蓝S07首发搭载，9月28日上市 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Deepal has announced a partnership with the Doubao large language model, with the new Deepal S07 set to be the first model to feature the technology. The car is scheduled to launch on September 28, bringing LLM capabilities into Deepal's mass-production vehicles.
items.why_zh: 这是国产大模型加速进入量产车载场景的又一落地案例，也关系到深蓝在智能座舱竞争中的位置。
items.why_en: It marks another case of a Chinese LLM moving into mass-production vehicles and shapes Deepal's position in the smart-cockpit race.

items.title_zh: 利用3D结构预测跨膜蛋白拓扑：基于图神经网络SchNet的新方法
items.title_en: Predicting Transmembrane Protein Topology from 3D Structure
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出用先进的图神经网络 SchNet 从三维结构推断蛋白质拓扑结构。模型在与 DeepTMHMM 相同的训练数据集上训练，并采用五折交叉验证。与此前仅使用蛋白质序列或α-碳原子作为特征的做法不同，该方法在分类器中使用了全原子级别的嵌入表示，且未使用任何预训练权重。结果显示，图神经网络在蛋白质拓扑预测任务上具有较大潜力，为结构驱动的膜蛋白研究提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to infer protein topology using the state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN), SchNet. The model is trained on the same dataset used to develop the recent DeepTMHMM model with 5-fold cross-validation. Unlike the conventional approaches based on using only the protein sequences or the $\alpha$-carbons as features, we have decoded our classifier in this way, so all atom-level embeddings are used. Without applying any pre-trained weight, the final results have shown great potential that GNNs can be used for top…
items.why_zh: 它表明全原子图神经网络在无需预训练的情况下即可用于膜蛋白拓扑预测，为结构生物学提供了新的技术路线。
items.why_en: It suggests all-atom GNNs can tackle membrane-protein topology prediction without pretraining, offering a new route for structural biology.

items.title_zh: BioEVAL：面向生物工程的全球多机构大语言与多模态模型基准
items.title_en: BioEVAL: A global, multi-institutional benchmark of large language and multimodal models for bioengineering
items.summary_zh: 研究团队构建了 BioEVAL（BioEngineering Validation of AI and LLMs），一个由全球多机构共同参与的基准计划，用于评估模型在生物工程各子领域的实验推理能力。该基准覆盖 11 个主要生物工程子领域以及一组未分类条目。作者指出，现有大模型评测偏重事实性回忆，难以反映模型在前沿任务和多模态任务上的表现。BioEVAL 正是为填补这一空白而设计，旨在更全面地衡量 AI 在生物工程中的实际推理水平。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated historic breakthroughs in general reasoning with early successes in biomedical science. However, existing LLM benchmarking emphasizes factual recall, offering limited insight into model performance on frontier and multimodal tasks. We assembled BioEVAL (BioEngineering Validation of AI and LLMs), a global, multi-institutional initiative designed to assess experimental reasoning capability across bioengineering (BE) subfields. BioEVAL spans 11 major BE subfields plus a set of uncategorized items, bring…
items.why_zh: 它把大模型评测从事实问答推进到生物工程实验推理与多模态任务，为评估 AI 在科研场景中的真实能力提供了统一标尺。
items.why_en: It pushes LLM evaluation beyond factual recall toward experimental reasoning and multimodal bioengineering tasks, offering a shared yardstick for AI's real research capability.

items.title_zh: LLM智能体社会中的金融脆弱性：协调失败与稳定机制
items.title_en: Financial Fragility in Societies of LLM Agents: Coordination Failures and Stabilizing Mechanisms
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，个体的自我保护性决策可能引发本可避免的集体失败，因此当大语言模型智能体在金融决策中扮演更重要角色时，金融 AI 安全不能只关注单个智能体，还要关注它们共同构成的系统。为此，作者提出受控实验框架 FRAIL，让 LLM 智能体置身于银行挤兑、债务展期与奖励众筹三种动态金融环境中，观察智能体决策如何重塑金融系统。研究关注协调失败如何出现，以及有哪些机制可以起到稳定作用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Individually protective decisions can produce avoidable collective failures. As large language model (LLM) agents take on greater roles in financial decision-making, financial AI safety must therefore be considered not only at the level of individual agents, but also at the level of the systems they jointly create. We study this problem with FRAIL, a controlled experimental framework that places LLM agents in three dynamic financial environments---bank runs, debt rollover, and reward crowdfunding---where agents' decisions reshape the financial co…
items.why_zh: 它把金融 AI 风险从单体模型层面提升到多智能体系统层面，为未来由 AI 参与的金融市场稳定性提供了实验性分析框架。
items.why_en: It reframes financial AI risk from individual models to multi-agent systems, offering an experimental framework for stability in AI-driven markets.

items.title_zh: 概念与组块（chunks）的统一解释：从Cobweb到扩展理论
items.title_en: A Unified Account of Concepts and Chunks
items.summary_zh: 认知心理学长期分别研究两类问题：人如何编码、使用和学习描述类别的概念，以及如何表征、识别和习得熟悉元素模式构成的组块（chunk）。这两条文献脉络几乎彼此独立，给统一认知理论带来挑战。本文回顾了关于分类与概念形成的计算模型 Cobweb，并提出一个纳入组块及其习得过程的扩展理论。作者强调该理论不对模态作出承诺，可适用于多种情境，从而在概念与组块之间架起桥梁。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cognitive psychology has studied how people encode, use, and learn concepts that describe categories, and how they represent, recognize, and acquire chunks for familiar patterns of elements. The literatures on these two topics are nearly disjoint, which poses a challenge for unified theories of cognition. In this paper, we review Cobweb, a computational account of categorization and concept formation, and propose an extended theory that incorporates chunks and their acquisition. The theory makes no commitments about modality, applying to any ex…
items.why_zh: 它尝试把认知科学中长期割裂的“概念”与“组块”研究纳入同一计算框架，可能推动更统一的认知理论与AI模型设计。
items.why_en: It attempts to unify the long-separated study of concepts and chunks within one computational account, potentially informing both cognitive theory and AI design.

items.title_zh: 评测即全部？通过评测设计策略性夸大LLM推理能力
items.title_en: Evaluation is All You Need: Strategic Overclaiming of LLM Reasoning Capabilities Through Evaluation Design
items.summary_zh: 研究指出，以 Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列为代表的推理模型因其在数学、科学、编程等领域表现强劲，已被开源社区广泛采用。然而该研究发现，这些模型的基准评测结果会受到多种因素影响而出现显著波动，评测条件上的细微差别就可能带来结果的巨大变化。类似现象也出现在其他基于 Deepseek-R1-Distill 系列微调的开源推理模型中。这表明仅凭现有基准分数判断模型能力存在风险，评测设计本身可能造成能力被夸大。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2506.04734v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reasoning models represented by the Deepseek-R1-Distill series have been widely adopted by the open-source community due to their strong performance in mathematics, science, programming, and other domains. However, our study reveals that their benchmark evaluation results are subject to significant fluctuations caused by various factors. Subtle differences in evaluation conditions can lead to substantial variations in results. Similar phenomena are observed in other open-source inference models fine-tuned based on the Deepseek-R1-Distill seri…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者和用户，基准分数并不等同于真实推理能力，评测设计的细微差异足以扭曲模型排名与结论。
items.why_en: It warns that benchmark scores are not the same as true reasoning ability, since subtle evaluation design choices can distort rankings and conclusions.

items.title_zh: 本地部署大模型的能效：消费级硬件上的GPU功耗量化基准初探
items.title_en: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
items.summary_zh: 出于隐私与本地推理需求，在个人设备上部署大语言模型正日益流行，但消费级硬件上的能耗成本仍缺乏刻画，因为多数基准只关注准确率。本文对 18 个开源大模型（0.5B 至 7B 参数）在单块消费级 GPU（RTX 4060ti 16GB）上的能耗表现进行了可复现的硬件级基准测试。实验使用 Ollama 推理引擎，通过 nvidia-smi 以 2Hz 频率在固定提示词集合上采样 GPU 功耗，从而评估模型规模与能耗之间的关系。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.00008v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of 18 open-source LLMs (0.5B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluat…
items.why_zh: 在隐私驱动下本地推理日益普及之际，它为“跑得动”之外的“耗多少电”提供了稀缺的量化数据。
items.why_en: As privacy drives local inference adoption, it supplies rare quantitative data on energy cost, not just whether models can run.

items.title_zh: HuPER：受人类启发的语音感知框架
items.title_en: HuPER: A Human-Inspired Framework for Phonetic Perception
items.summary_zh: 研究者提出 HuPER，一个受人类启发的语音感知框架，把语音感知建模为在声学-语音证据与语言知识之上的自适应推理过程。仅使用 100 小时训练数据，HuPER 就在五个英语基准上取得了当前最优的音素错误率，并能零样本迁移到 95 种未见语言。它还是首个支持在多样声学条件下进行自适应、多路径语音感知的框架。研究团队开源了全部训练数据、模型与代码，并提供了代码与演示链接。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.01634v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose HuPER, a human-inspired framework that models phonetic perception as adaptive inference over acoustic-phonetics evidence and linguistic knowledge. With only 100 hours of training data, HuPER achieves state-of-the-art phonetic error rates on five English benchmarks and strong zero-shot transfer to 95 unseen languages. HuPER is also the first framework to enable adaptive, multi-path phonetic perception under diverse acoustic conditions. All training data, models, and code are open-sourced. Code and demo avaliable at https://git…
items.why_zh: 它以极少的数据实现多语言零样本语音感知并全面开源，有望降低语音技术对大规模标注数据的依赖。
items.why_en: It achieves strong zero-shot multilingual phonetic perception with minimal data and is fully open-sourced, potentially reducing speech tech's reliance on massive labeled datasets.

items.title_zh: 科学界大模型的"寿命"正在缩短
items.title_en: The Shrinking Lifespan of LLMs in Science
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文指出，缩放定律只描述语言模型能力如何随算力和数据增长，却没有说明模型发布后能"重要"多久。作者提出"到达峰值所需时间"和"寿命"两个指标来衡量模型过时程度，并据此分析了 62 个语言模型在 2019 至 2025 年间超过 10.8 万篇引用论文中的科学采用轨迹；通过区分"主动采用"与"背景引用"，还原出单纯引用计数无法分辨的逐模型轨迹。研究发现，模型的长寿程度更多取决于其发布时间，而非其他因素。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.07530v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Scaling laws describe how language model capabilities grow with compute and data, but say nothing about how long a model matters once released. We introduce time-to-peak and lifespan as measures of model obsolescence and use them to characterize the scientific adoption trajectories of 62 LLMs across more than 108k citing papers (2019-2025), separating active adoption from background citation to recover per-model trajectories that citation counts cannot resolve. We find that a model's longevity is shaped more by when it was released than…
items.why_zh: 它把"模型过时速度"变成可量化指标，为科研选型、资源投入和模型维护策略提供了实证依据。
items.why_en: It turns model obsolescence into a quantifiable metric, offering evidence for research tooling choices, resource allocation, and model maintenance strategy.

items.title_zh: PALM：面向金融语言模型的时点适配
items.title_en: PALM: Point-in-Time Adaptation for Financial Language Models
items.summary_zh: 用于金融回测的语言模型存在前视偏差：如果模型训练语料包含研究期之后发布的文本，它就相当于已经"看过"自己要预测的结果。业界为此采用时点（PIT）语言模型，在按时间过滤的语料上预训练，并按日历年发布一个带明确截止日期的检查点。但每多一年就要多跑一次完整预训练，这种代价是否必要此前从未被检验。本文正是针对这一问题展开研究，探索以时点适配替代逐年全量预训练的路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models used in financial backtests suffer from look-ahead bias, as a model trained on text published after the study period has already observed the outcomes it is asked to predict. To handle this issue, point-in-time (PIT) language models are pretrained on chronologically filtered corpora and released as one checkpoint per calendar year, each with a documented cutoff. However, each additional year costs a full pretraining run, and whether that run is necessary has never been tested. In this paper, we show that the annual pretraining run…
items.why_zh: 若能免去逐年全量预训练，金融机构可在保持回测无前视偏差的同时大幅降低算力成本。
items.why_en: If annual full pretraining can be avoided, financial institutions could keep look-ahead-free backtests while sharply cutting compute costs.

items.title_zh: 联邦式目标最大似然估计：分散数据下的因果推断
items.title_en: Federated Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation
items.summary_zh: 许多科学或业务决策所依赖的证据分散在医院、银行或登记机构手中，这些机构无法汇总个体观测数据。跨孤岛联邦学习把计算搬到数据端，只交换双方认可的汇总信息；而目标最大似然估计（TMLE）能对灵活的初始拟合进行修正，得到尊重模型结构且支持高效推断的插入式估计量，但 TMLE 本身一直只能在集中式环境下运行。本文提出首个联邦 TMLE 算法，填补了这一空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The evidence behind a scientific or operational decision is often held by hospitals, banks, or registries that cannot pool individual observations. Cross-silo federated learning moves computation to the data and exchanges agreed summaries. Targeted maximum likelihood estimation (TMLE) refines a flexible initial fit, yielding plug-in estimators that respect the model and support efficient inference. TMLE itself, however, has remained a fully centralized procedure. To fill this gap, our paper introduces the first federated TMLE algorithm. We federa…
items.why_zh: 它让严格的因果推断方法能在数据无法出域的场景中使用，兼顾隐私合规与统计效率。
items.why_en: It brings rigorous causal inference to settings where data cannot leave its silo, combining privacy compliance with statistical efficiency.

items.title_zh: PixSim：面向即时支付欺诈的开源校准仿真器
items.title_en: PixSim: a calibrated open-source simulator of instant-payment fraud, recovery and interdiction under analyst capacity constraints
items.summary_zh: 巴西的 Pix 系统每月处理约 59 亿笔即时且不可撤销的转账；欺诈资金只有在仍停留在可追踪账户时才能被追回，2025 年巴西央行 MED 追回机制仅返还了被受理争议金额的 9%。因此拦截必须发生在结算之前，需要把每笔交易分派为放行、人工审核或阻断，同时受限于有限的分析师团队和监管冻结窗口。据作者所知，此前没有公开的仿真器能同时建模不可撤销结算、受监管的追回机制等要素，PixSim 正是为此构建的校准开源工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Brazil's Pix settles about 5.9 billion instant, irreversible transfers a month. A fraudulent transfer can be recovered only while the funds remain in a traceable account, and in 2025 the Central Bank's recovery mechanism (MED) returned 9% of accepted contested value. Interdiction therefore has to happen before settlement, by routing each transaction to pass, human review or block, under a finite analyst team and a regulatory hold window. To our knowledge no public simulator jointly models irreversible settlement, a regulated recovery mechanism, d…
items.why_zh: 它为支付欺诈拦截策略提供了可复现的实验平台，直接关系到数十亿笔即时转账的资金安全。
items.why_en: It offers a reproducible testbed for payment-fraud interdiction policies, directly relevant to safeguarding billions of instant transfers.

items.title_zh: 从开发者视角看"分布式学习即服务"
items.title_en: Distributed Learning as a Service: The Developer's Perspective
items.summary_zh: 分布式学习服务的应用开发者会面对典型联邦学习流程无法覆盖的难题：模型更新仍可能泄露隐私数据，部分设备因资源受限无法参与训练，单一聚合器可能无法扩展，模型权重的传输还会带来可观带宽开销。本文从开发者视角展示 DLaaS（分布式学习即服务），开发者可通过单一管理仪表盘启动相关流程，从而在应用层面同时应对隐私、设备异构、可扩展性与通信成本等现实约束。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Application developers of distributed learning services face challenges that a typical federated learning loop does not address. Specifically, the model updates can still leak private data, devices might not be able to participate in the training due to limited resources, a single aggregator might not be able to scale, and the transmissions of model weights induce a considerable bandwidth cost. This paper demonstrates DLaaS (Distributed Learning as a Service) from the developer's vantage point. Using a single admin dashboard, the developer initia…
items.why_zh: 它把联邦学习的工程难点前移到面向开发者的服务接口，降低了在真实应用中落地分布式训练的门槛。
items.why_en: It pushes federated learning's engineering hurdles into a developer-facing service layer, lowering the barrier to deploying distributed training in real applications.

items.title_zh: KV Cache 成为新的"内存墙"
items.title_en: The KV Cache Is the New Memory Wall
items.summary_zh: 长上下文下的自回归大模型推理受限于内存带宽而非算术吞吐，随着序列长度增长，瓶颈资源正从模型权重转向键值（KV）缓存。以 BF16 精度的 Llama-3-70B 为例，140 GB 的权重已超过单张加速器 80 GB 的 HBM，而一条 12.8 万 token 的序列还会额外占用 42 GB 的 KV 缓存。压缩、驱逐、分页、共享或卸载 KV 状态的技术层出不穷，但各报告使用的负载、硬件和质量指标不一致，导致跨论文结果难以比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30854v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autoregressive LLM inference at long context is bounded by memory bandwidth, not arithmetic throughput, and the binding resource shifts from model weights to the Key-Value (KV) cache as sequence length grows. For Llama-3-70B in BF16, the 140 GB weight footprint exceeds the 80 GB HBM of a single accelerator, and one 128k-token sequence adds 42 GB of KV cache. Techniques that compress, evict, page, share, or offload KV state have proliferated, but reported gains use inconsistent workloads, hardware, and quality metrics, preventing cross-paper com…
items.why_zh: 它指出长上下文推理的真实瓶颈已变成 KV 缓存，凸显统一评测口径的紧迫性。
items.why_en: It identifies the KV cache as the true bottleneck for long-context inference, underscoring the urgent need for consistent benchmarking.

items.title_zh: 几何复杂度增长下的非参数上下文学习：Transformer 的极小极大最优性与局部几何自适应
items.title_en: Nonparametric In-Context Learning under Growing Geometric Complexity: Minimax Optimality and Local Geometry-Adaptivity of Transformers
items.summary_zh: Transformer 已成为上下文学习（ICL）的核心架构，其在大语言模型中的领先表现促使人们研究它如何利用几何异构数据中的任务相关结构。然而已有的非参数 ICL 理论大多局限于欧氏空间或单一流形设定。为填补这一空白，本文研究未知局部几何条件下的预测问题，用依赖样本量、由异构流形混合而成的模型来刻画该几何，并给出 Transformer 的极小极大最优性与局部几何自适应性质的分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31458v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Transformers have become a central architecture for in-context learning (ICL), particularly through their state-of-the-art performance in large language models. This success motivates understanding how transformers exploit task-relevant structure in geometrically heterogeneous data. However, existing nonparametric ICL theory has largely focused on Euclidean domains or single-manifold models. To address this gap, we study the prediction problem under unknown local geometry, modeled by sample size-dependent mixtures of manifolds with heterogeneou…
items.why_zh: 它为理解 Transformer 在复杂真实数据几何下的上下文学习能力提供了理论刻画。
items.why_en: It provides a theoretical account of how transformers perform in-context learning under complex, real-world data geometry.

items.title_zh: Bergson：面向数据归因的开源库
items.title_en: Bergson: An Open Source Library for Data Attribution
items.summary_zh: 数据归因是可解释性中颇具前景的方向，它试图通过训练数据的影响来解释模型行为，可用于调试不理想的模型表现、筛选训练数据集等。但在大规模场景下开展数据归因需要大量工程投入，许多前沿技术也缺乏开源工具与支持。Bergson 是一个开源库，旨在提供可扩展到超大规模语言模型的多种技术，从而推动该领域更快取得进展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.11660v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Data attribution is a promising field in interpretability that aims to explain model behavior through the influence of its training data, with applications including debugging undesirable model behavior and training dataset curation. However, significant engineering effort is required to perform it at scale, and many cutting edge techniques lack open-source tooling and support. Bergson is an open source library that aims to enable faster progress in the field by providing a host of techniques that scale to very large language models and pre-t…
items.why_zh: 它把规模化数据归因的前沿方法工具化，降低了可解释性研究与数据集治理的使用门槛。
items.why_en: It packages frontier data-attribution methods into usable tooling, lowering the barrier for interpretability research and dataset curation.

items.title_zh: 邓白氏推出全新 AI 驱动能力
items.title_en: Dun & Bradstreet Launches New AI-Powered Capabilities
items.summary_zh: 据 ABF Journal 报道，商业数据与分析公司邓白氏（Dun & Bradstreet）宣布推出新的 AI 驱动能力。目前公开信息仅止于这一发布本身，报道未说明这些能力的具体功能、覆盖哪些产品线以及何时上线。作为以企业信用与商业数据见长的老牌公司，邓白氏此举延续了将 AI 融入数据与分析产品的方向，更多细节有待官方进一步公布。
items.summary_en: Dun & Bradstreet Launches New AI-Powered Capabilities ABF Journal
items.why_zh: 商业数据巨头把 AI 能力嵌入自身产品体系，反映出企业级数据分析正在加速 AI 化。
items.why_en: The move shows how business-data providers are embedding AI into their products as enterprise analytics goes AI-native.

items.title_zh: 华为开源盘古 openPangu-2.0 的预训练、SFT 代码和后训练 RL 代码正式开源上线
items.title_en: Huawei Open-Sources openPangu-2.0 Pretraining, SFT and Post-Training RL Code
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，华为今日宣布， 开源盘古 openPangu-2.0 的预训练、 SFT 代码和后训练 RL 代码正式开源上线 。 开源盘古 openPangu 是华为开源 AI 模型品牌，致力于通过昇腾原生训练与推理技术，为业界用好昇腾提供最佳实践参考。 openPangu-2.0 模型相关组件已陆续上线开源平台。IT之家附开源地址如下： https://gitcode.com/ascend-tribe/openPangu-2.0-Training https://gitcode.com/ascend-tribe/openPangu-2.0-RL
items.summary_en: Huawei said on Sept 28 that it has open-sourced the pretraining, SFT and post-training RL code for its openPangu-2.0 model, with components rolling out on GitCode. The openPangu brand focuses on Ascend-native training and inference, and Huawei frames the release as a best-practice reference for using Ascend hardware.
items.why_zh: 从预训练到 RL 后训练的完整代码开源，为开发者基于昇腾生态复现和二次开发大模型提供了实操范本。
items.why_en: Releasing the full pipeline from pretraining to RL gives developers a practical template for building models on Huawei's Ascend stack.

items.title_zh: 智谱ZCode宣布开源并删除涉事云端数据
items.title_en: Zhipu's ZCode Says It Will Open-Source and Has Deleted the Cloud Data Involved
items.summary_zh: 智谱ZCode宣布开源并删除涉事云端数据 DoNews
items.summary_en: Zhipu's ZCode announced it will open-source the product and has deleted the cloud data involved in a recent incident, according to DoNews. The report does not detail what the data was, what triggered the incident, or the scope and timing of the open-sourcing.
items.why_zh: 在数据合规争议之下选择删除数据并开源，是国产 AI 编程工具在信任与透明度上的一次公开姿态。
items.why_en: Deleting the data and promising open source is a public bid for trust and transparency amid data-compliance concerns around AI coding tools.

items.title_zh: 智谱ZCode宣布已删除涉事云端数据，赠送用户多张重置卡和1亿Token
items.title_en: Zhipu's ZCode Says Involved Cloud Data Deleted, Gives Users Reset Cards and 100 Million Tokens
items.summary_zh: 智谱ZCode宣布已删除涉事云端数据，赠送用户多张重置卡和1亿Token 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: Zhipu's ZCode said it has deleted the cloud data involved in the incident and is compensating users with multiple reset cards and 100 million tokens, according to Phoenix Tech. Details of the data involved and how the compensation will be distributed were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 以删除数据加用户补偿的方式收尾，为 AI 工具的数据安全事件处理提供了一个可参照的样本。
items.why_en: Combining data deletion with user compensation offers a reference model for how AI tool makers handle data-security incidents.

items.title_zh: 深蓝汽车第 100 万辆整车正式量产下线
items.title_en: Deepal Rolls Out Its 1 Millionth Vehicle as the New S07 AI Laser Edition Launches
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，深蓝汽车官方今日宣布， 深蓝汽车第 100 万辆整车正式量产下线 。 据IT之家此前报道，9 月 1 日，深蓝汽车宣布， 8 月全球销量 28,659 辆 ，全球累计销量突破 94.76 万辆。深蓝目前覆盖全球超 100 个国家和地区， 预计年内将稳步跨入百万用户俱乐部 。 延伸阅读 公开资料显示，深蓝品牌的起点可追溯至 2018 年 5 月 28 日成立的重庆长安新能源汽车科技有限公司，该公司是长安汽车“香格里拉计划”新能源战略的主要承载者；2022 年 1 月长安汽车正式发布“深蓝”新能源品牌并公布首款车型深蓝 SL03，2023 年 4 月公司更名为深蓝汽车科技有限公司。目前长安汽车持有深蓝汽车 50.9959% 股权，为其控股股东。 深蓝 SL03 基于 EPA1 全电数字平台打造，可兼容纯电、增程、氢电三种动力形式，2022 年 7 月上市，同年 12 月交付量即突破万辆，仅用 17 个月便实现 10 万辆销售成绩。 目前深蓝汽车已形成涵盖 SL03、L07、L06、S05、S07、S09、G318 等多款车型的产品矩阵。此次第 100 万辆量产的节点，与全新深蓝 S07 AI 激光版于 9 月 28 日上市同步，该车由深蓝汽车与火山引擎围绕豆包大模型及智能座舱深度共创，定位“长续航 AI 激光智能 SUV”。 在核心三电领域，深蓝自研的原…
items.summary_en: Deepal said on Sept 28 that its 1 millionth vehicle has rolled off the line, after August global sales of 28,659 units and cumulative sales of over 947,600 vehicles. The same day, the new Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition launched, co-developed with Volcano Engine around the Doubao model and smart cockpit.
items.why_zh: 百万辆下线叠加 AI 座舱新车上市，显示传统车企孵化的新能源品牌正把大模型当作下一阶段的竞争抓手。
items.why_en: Hitting one million vehicles while launching an AI-cockpit model shows EV spinoffs of legacy automakers are betting on large models for the next phase of competition.

items.title_zh: 车载冰箱实际使用率仅 5% 引热议，深蓝汽车邓承浩回应称使用率低并不是否定价值
items.title_en: Car Fridge Used Only 5% of the Time? Deepal's Deng Cheng-hao Says Low Usage Doesn't Negate Its Value
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，在上周末的 2026 世界新能源汽车大会（WNEVC）上，重庆长安汽车股份有限公司副总裁、深蓝汽车科技有限公司董事长 邓承浩的一番发言引发网络热议 。 邓承浩表示，上一轮行业创新很多是单点突破，但硬件堆砌不等于真实体验。有一组数据很有参考性： 车上的冰箱，用户实际使用率仅 5%；后排娱乐屏、车载 KTV，用户全年使用不超过十次 。 他认为，产品成功不再依靠简单硬件堆砌， 体系化能力才是制胜关键 。 IT之家注意到，邓承浩 9 月 27 日在微博发布回应消息，表示自己在大会上表达的观点，是在行业激烈竞争的今天，单点式突破正在失效，简单的硬件堆砌已经无法构筑竞争壁垒，体系化能力才是致胜的关键。 而说回车载冰箱，使用率低并不是对它价值的否定 ，对于用户尤其是家庭用户而言，它一定能在日常生活中带来更好的用车体验。也正因如此，在深蓝 S09、S07、G318 等车型上，我们都提供了车载冰箱的配置选项。在明天上市的全新深蓝 S07 AI 激光版上，也会有车载智能冷暖箱供大家选择。
items.summary_en: At WNEVC 2026, Deepal chairman Deng Cheng-hao said car fridges are used only about 5% of the time and rear screens or in-car karaoke fewer than ten times a year, arguing hardware stacking doesn't equal real experience. He later clarified on Weibo that low usage doesn't negate the fridge's value, noting Deepal still offers it on several models.
items.why_zh: 高管公开质疑“硬件堆砌”，把智能汽车竞争焦点从配置表拉回到真实体验与体系化能力。
items.why_en: A senior executive publicly questioning hardware stacking shifts the smart-car race from spec sheets back to real user experience and system-level capability.

items.title_zh: 美知名综艺《周六夜现场》恶搞 Anthropic 阿莫代伊：演员高喊“AI 是魔鬼，我造的”
items.title_en: 'SNL' Parodies Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei: "AI Is the Devil, I Made It"
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，当地时间 26 日晚，Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊“登上”了美国知名综艺节目《周六夜现场》，还参与了和“自己”争论的环节。 节目中，简 · 威克莱恩在自己成为常驻演员后的首个季度模仿阿莫代伊，把他塑造成一个 笨拙、自大的人 ，试图解释 为什么自己创造的技术不会毁灭世界 。 威克莱恩笔下的阿莫代伊有两种人格： 一个深谙媒体应对之道，另一个完全没有这种训练，而且令人不安 。整个片段中，两种人格数次直接对话。 《周末新闻播报》主持人迈克尔 · 切问威克莱恩 AI 有什么好处时，两个阿莫代伊又开始互相说话。 受过媒体训练的那个人格说：“ 赶紧收尾吧，达里奥 。” 另一个人格回答：“ 我做不到 。” 本月早些时候，现实中的阿莫代伊在个人网站发表了一篇措辞十分严肃的文章称，AI 模型正在迅速脱离控制，呼吁前沿 AI 公司协调放慢开发速度，同时接受政府监管。最近几周，阿莫代伊却又开始大力宣传 Anthropic 在医学研究和蛋白质结构方面取得的突破，也不再发表有关 AI 末日的严重警告式预测。 然而截至目前，各界围绕 AI 安全发出的警告，仍未让华盛顿或硅谷形成 支持暂停或放慢技术开发 的相对多数意见。 《周六夜现场》显然没有因此停手。威克莱恩饰演的阿莫代伊在节目中喊道：“ AI 是魔鬼，我就是它的创造者 ！” 这段节目至少得到了一位 AI 界…
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei was spoofed on "Saturday Night Live" on Sept 26, with cast member Jane Wickline playing him as two personalities—one media-trained, one unnervingly unguarded—who argue on "Weekend Update" before she shouts, "AI is the devil, I made it." The sketch lands as Amodei has shifted from warnings about runaway AI to promoting Anthropic's medical-research and protein-structure work.
items.why_zh: 顶级 AI 掌门人被大众综艺调侃，说明 AI 安全争论已从行业内部走向流行文化，也让“放慢开发”的呼吁更受审视。
items.why_en: Parodying a top AI CEO shows the AI-safety debate has entered pop culture, putting calls to slow development under broader public scrutiny.

items.title_zh: 全球首台搭载全国产化电子架构的具身智能机器人亮相，提供可完整替代国外方案技术选项
items.title_en: World's First Embodied AI Robot With a Fully Domestic Electronic Architecture Debuts
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，据央视新闻报道，国产化电子架构具身智能机器人发布会于今日（9 月 28 日）在湖北宜昌举行， 全球首台搭载全国产化电子架构的具身智能机器人正式亮相 。 电子架构是决定整机性能上限的“智能神经系统”，包括操作系统、网络、工具软件和 AI 计算芯片。专家介绍，如果把机器人看作一个“人”，那么电子架构就是它的神经系统 —— 大脑思考得再周密，没有神经系统，行动就无从发生。 据介绍，这套国产化电子架构可以实现控制与 AI 智能计算的隔离融合，构建从 AI 决策到物理执行的全国产化技术底座， 提供可完整替代国外方案的技术选项 。 国家工业信息安全发展研究中心测试人员对机器人开展技术验证，在关节破坏、网络攻击、病毒植入等情况下，传统电子架构机器人出现线路失效、瞬间关机、系统失控等情况，而 全国产化电子架构机器人通过了严苛安全测试，并保持安全运行能力，展现了全国产化电子架构的实时控制、快速响应、故障隔离、防攻击与系统安全能力 。 报道称，全国产化电子架构保障机器人的内生安全和产业主权安全，为机器人自主行为划定刚性安全边界，确保其不破坏生产、不危及人员安全，让人工智能在物理世界安全、可信、可控，构建驾驭物理 AI 的安全驾驭系统（Harness），充分实现智能机器人行业的主权安全。 近年来，国产机器人底层技术在加快形成产业协同。从零部件单点突破，到软硬件系统融合，再…
items.summary_en: A launch event in Yichang, Hubei on Sept 28 unveiled what organizers call the world's first embodied AI robot built on a fully domestic Chinese electronic architecture, spanning OS, networking, tool software and AI chips. Testing by a state industrial-security center showed it kept running under joint-damage, cyberattack and virus-injection scenarios that disabled conventional architectures.
items.why_zh: 从 AI 芯片到操作系统全链路国产化的机器人架构，指向具身智能领域的供应链自主与安全可控。
items.why_en: A robot stack sourced domestically from AI chips to OS points to supply-chain independence and safety control in embodied AI.

items.title_zh: 华境 S 大六座 SUV 交付突破 3 万台销量创新高：标配华为乾崑智驾 ADS Pro 增强版，14.98 万元起
items.title_en: Wuling-Huawei Huajing S SUV Tops 30,000 Deliveries, Standard Huawei Qiankun ADS Pro
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，华境汽车官方今日宣布，华境 S 大六座 SUV 达成又一里程碑 —— 累计交付突破 3 万台，销量创新高 。 据IT之家了解，华境 S 是上汽通用五菱与华为合作的首款搭载华为乾崑科技旗舰大六座 SUV，2026 年 7 月交付 7203 台、6 月交付 5689 台。华境 S 全系标配华为乾崑智驾 ADS Pro 增强版与鸿蒙座舱。 该车已于 5 月 8 日正式上市 。 本月中旬（9 月 12 日），华境 S 新增 4 款配置，全系超级置换价 14.98 万元-19.68 万元。新增的 4 款配置主要在鸿蒙座舱方面迎来升级，搭载 MoLA 2.0 混合大模型架构，支持方言交流识别，车机 UI 迎来焕新。 200km 乾崑悦享版：官方指导价 16.98 万元，超级置换价 14.98 万元。 200km 乾崑悦享鸿蒙 +：官方指导价 16.28 万元，超级置换价 15.28 万元。 255km 乾崑臻享版：官方指导价 17.58 万元，超级置换价 16.58 万元。 255km 乾崑臻享鸿蒙 +：官方指导价 17.88 万元，超级置换价 16.88 万元。 255km 乾崑尊享版：官方指导价 18.58 万元，超级置换价 17.58 万元。 255km 乾崑尊享鸿蒙 +：官方指导价 18.88 万元，超级置换价 17.88 万元。 235km 四驱乾崑尊…
items.summary_en: Huajing Auto said its Huajing S six-seat SUV has surpassed 30,000 cumulative deliveries. Developed jointly by SAIC-GM-Wuling and Huawei, it launched on May 8 with Huawei's Qiankun ADS Pro advanced driver assistance and HarmonyOS cockpit as standard. On Sept 12 it added four trims with the MoLA 2.0 hybrid large-model cockpit, priced from 149,800 yuan after trade-in.
items.why_zh: 这是华为智驾方案在上汽通用五菱量产车型上的规模化落地，交付破 3 万台说明华为智能化方案在中低价位市场的接受度正在提升。
items.why_en: It shows Huawei's smart-driving stack scaling on a mass-market SAIC-GM-Wuling model, signaling growing acceptance of Huawei intelligence in lower-priced segments.

items.title_zh: 美通社在亚太区推出面向 AI 品牌可见度的 AEO 与 GEO 报告
items.title_en: PR Newswire Launches AEO & GEO Report for AI Brand Visibility in APAC Region
items.summary_zh: 美通社（PR Newswire）宣布在亚太区推出 AEO 与 GEO 报告，聚焦品牌在 AI 生成内容与 AI 搜索环境中的可见度。该报告旨在帮助亚太区企业了解其品牌在 AI 问答、搜索引擎生成式结果等渠道中的曝光表现。目前公布的信息主要为产品发布本身，具体评估方法、覆盖范围与指标细节尚未披露。
items.summary_en: PR Newswire Launches AEO & GEO Report for AI Brand Visibility in APAC Region PR Newswire
items.why_zh: 随着 AI 搜索与生成式问答成为新的流量入口，品牌可见度的衡量方式正在从传统 SEO 向 AEO/GEO 迁移。
items.why_en: As AI search and generative answers become new discovery gateways, brand visibility measurement is shifting from classic SEO toward AEO/GEO.

items.summary_en: A weekly AI investment roundup reports that DeepSeek has raised another 50 billion yuan, underscoring continued heavy capital flow into leading large-model companies in China. Further details such as investor lists and valuation were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 超大额融资显示资本仍在大举押注头部大模型公司，行业资金集中度进一步提高。
items.why_en: A mega-round of this size shows capital still betting heavily on leading model developers, further concentrating funding in the sector's top players.

items.summary_en: A 21 Finance analysis looks at the positioning battle behind Zhipu AI's latest funding round, framing competition among Chinese large-model companies as a quiet contest for capital and ecosystem position. Specific funding figures and investors were not disclosed in the summary.
items.why_zh: 在大模型竞争进入下半场后，融资能力与生态卡位正成为决定厂商能否留在牌桌的关键。
items.why_en: As the large-model race matures, fundraising power and ecosystem positioning are becoming decisive for which players stay at the table.

items.title_zh: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5 模型偷跑，实测碾压 GPT-6 Sol、直逼 Astra
items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 Leaks, Reportedly Beats GPT-6 Sol in Tests
items.summary_zh: 谁能想到，Opus 5.5 发布才没几天，Sonnet 5.5 也要来了？ 从昨晚开始，整个 X 都在流传这个消息： Sonnet 5.5 很快就要发布了，或许就是美国时间周二下午 。 在性能上，Sonnet 5.5 更接近 Opus 5.5，但却比 Opus 5.5 便宜得多。 现在，Sonnet 5.5 已经进入发布前的最后阶段，已经在 Claude Code 中开启灰度测试。 多位内测大佬曝出的 demo 显示， Sonnet 5.5 碾压了刚发布的 GPT-6 Sol ，甚至在编码和 Agent 能力上直逼 OpenAI 的旗舰大杯 GPT-6 Astra！ 更震撼的是，它的价格直接打穿地心， 低至百万 token 输入只要 2 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 13.4 元人民币） 。 如果爆料发布时间属实，看来 Anthropic 是铁了心要狙击 OpenAI 的 Dev Dayl 了。 Sonnet 5.5 泄露，专属模型标识符已出现 还记得 9 月 22 日，Anthriopic 突然发布 Opus 5.5 时，顺手在官方文档里写了一句：「 Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5 将在未来几周内推出 」。 谁都没想到，Sonnet 5.5 会来得这么快！ 就在昨天，开发者大 V @Mr_Salio 在 X 上爆料： Claude Sonnet 5.5 被抓包了！…
items.summary_en: Leaks circulating on X suggest Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 has entered final pre-release testing in Claude Code, with a dedicated model identifier already spotted. Internal demos reportedly show it outperforming the newly launched GPT-6 Sol and approaching OpenAI's flagship GPT-6 Astra in coding and agent tasks, at a claimed price of just $2 per million input tokens.
items.why_zh: 若爆料属实，Sonnet 5.5 以更低价格逼近旗舰能力，将进一步加剧 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 在中端模型及编码 Agent 市场的性能与价格竞争。
items.why_en: If accurate, Sonnet 5.5 would bring near-flagship capability at a much lower price, intensifying the price-and-performance race between Anthropic and OpenAI in mid-tier models and coding agents.

items.title_zh: 黑客在暗网兜售 AI 模型访问权限，最低价仅有正版 3%
items.title_en: Hackers Sell AI Model Access on Dark Web at as Little as 3% of Official Price
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，据英国《金融时报》当地时间 26 日报道，非法获取 AI 模型和算力，正迅速成为网络犯罪黑市上最抢手的商品，黑客希望借助价格高昂的大模型实施勒索、网络战和间谍活动。 谷歌威胁情报团队首席分析师约翰 · 霍特奎斯特披露，今年所谓“LLM 劫持”活动明显增多，具体表现于 倒卖公开 AI 工具的被盗登录凭据 ，以及部分团体盗用他人算力，以免费运行自己的模型。 从事网络安全工作 20 年的霍特奎斯特坦言：“我们在地下市场看到，一个围绕 AI 使用权限形成的经济体系在不断壮大。” 霍特奎斯特警告，攻击者能够 以低廉价格使用原本昂贵的 AI ，从而在成本上占据优势，被攻击方为了防御同样需要使用这些 AI 工具。“归根结底，这些做法让他们在与我们对抗时拥有某种经济或效率优势，因为他们能以低得多的价格获得这些 token。” 谷歌威胁情报团队研究人员发现，暗网市场出售 Anthropic、谷歌和 OpenAI 等公司的 AI 模型使用权限， 折扣最高达到 97% 。作为对照，ChatGPT 和 Claude 最高级版本的订阅价格则可达到每名用户每月 200 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,346 元人民币） 。 霍特奎斯特称，AI 实验室会监测滥用迹象，因此部分卖家甚至推出“保证访问”服务，承诺初始账户一旦遭到封禁，就不收取额外费用，直接提供新的登录凭据。 还有…
items.summary_en: The Financial Times reports that stolen AI models and compute are becoming hot commodities on the cybercrime black market, with hackers using them for ransomware, cyberwarfare, and espionage. Google's threat intelligence team says 'LLM hijacking' is rising, with dark web sellers offering access to Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI models at discounts of up to 97%.
items.why_zh: AI 访问权限的黑市化意味着攻击者能以极低成本获取强大模型，可能加剧勒索、间谍等网络犯罪，并迫使防御方承担更高成本。
items.why_en: The emergence of a black market for AI access gives attackers a major cost advantage, potentially fueling ransomware, espionage, and other cybercrime while raising defense costs.

items.summary_en: Music startup Thoughtful Things has just launched the Kickstarter campaign for its first instrument, Engram . It's a sampler and groovebox that uses AI to mangle incoming audio and even hallucinate completely new sounds. This isn't Suno in a box, though. This isn't a "push-button, get-song" device, aimed at creating something that sounds ready for top-40 radio. It's about creating experimental, uncanny sounds and pushing AI audio models beyond their limits. Engram isn't connected to the internet. Instead, it runs a "tiny AI" locally. According to the Kickstarter listing, the model is designed…
items.why_zh: 它展示了 AI 音频的另一条路径：不是生成流行歌曲，而是把模型的“幻觉”当作创作素材。
items.why_en: It shows an alternative path for AI audio: treating model hallucinations as creative material rather than generating pop songs.

items.title_zh: 消息称小米 18 Pro 系列手机均为 TLC 颗粒，没有 QLC
items.title_en: Report: Xiaomi 18 Pro Series Uses TLC Flash Only, No QLC
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 27 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 今日发文确认，小米 18 Pro 系列全都是 TLC 颗粒，没有 QLC。 他补充道：“另外这次闪存有多家供应商，其中就包括国产的飞存闪拓，闪存颗粒和主控跟长江存储压根是一套。现在 TOP5 厂商很多主力产品都在用，并不是所谓的杂牌”。 另据博主 @体验more 透露，小米 18 Pro 的全版本闪存是 海力士和铠侠 ，只有小米 18 Pro Max 的 512GB 版本是 海力士和飞存闪拓 ，而且都是 TLC，没有 QLC。 IT之家注意到，小米 18 Pro 手机于 9 月 23 日发布，搭载妙享背屏，支持背屏动态通知、AI 百变背屏，首批上线 100+ 背屏应用卡，包含快捷小工具、信息通知栏、解压小游戏等，售价 5999 元起。 小米 18 Pro 首发第六代骁龙 8 至尊版，采用最新一代 2nm 旗舰制程，电池容量升级至 7000mAh，搭载全焦段徕卡光学三摄。该机的屏幕尺寸为 6.4 英寸，采用全新 M11 发光体系，峰值亮度 4000nits，支持硬件级智能防窥。 ▲ 小米 18 Pro
items.summary_en: Tipster @Digital Chat Station says the Xiaomi 18 Pro series uses only TLC flash memory, with no QLC. The flash suppliers reportedly include domestic brand Feicun Shantuo, whose NAND and controller match Yangtze Memory's solution. Another tipster says most Xiaomi 18 Pro versions use Hynix and Kioxia flash, while only the 512GB Xiaomi 18 Pro Max uses Hynix and Feicun Shantuo. The Xiaomi 18 Pro launched on Sept. 23 starting at 5,999 yuan.
items.why_zh: 闪存颗粒类型直接影响手机性能与寿命，该消息澄清了用户对小米旗舰机可能混用 QLC 的担忧。
items.why_en: Flash type affects performance and longevity, and this report addresses user concerns about possible QLC mixing in Xiaomi's flagship lineup.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，腾讯 QQ 今日宣布， QQ 宠物正式登陆华为鸿蒙系统 ，主打轻量化社交陪伴体验。 会喊饿、爱黏人、偶尔还有点小傲娇 ~ 还会卖萌、串门，到处交朋友。 现在这只小家伙已经蹦跶进鸿蒙系统， 准备继续靠可爱萌混过关了。 据IT之家此前报道，本月早些时候，腾讯 QQ 鸿蒙版 App 在华为应用市场（App Gallery）开启 9.2.65 (3426) 版本邀测升级（需收到短信通知后点击链接跳转安装）， 新增 QQ 宠物功能 。 作为参考， 腾讯全新 QQ 宠物已于今年 7 月 27 日正式上线 。在手机 QQ 打开功能入口，或者直接搜索“QQ 宠物”，即可进入该玩法。用户可以将宠物带出门学习、打工等，基本延续了原版 QQ 宠物的玩法。 相关阅读： 《 QQ 宠物全新升级归来，接入腾讯 Hy3 大模型 》 《 腾讯 QQ 鸿蒙版 App 获 9.2.65 邀测升级，新增宠物功能 》
items.summary_en: Tencent's QQ Pet has officially arrived on Huawei HarmonyOS, emphasizing lightweight social companionship. Users can access it via the QQ app or search, taking pets out to study or work much like the original. The new QQ Pet launched on July 27, and the HarmonyOS QQ app added the feature in a recent beta build.
items.why_zh: 这是腾讯经典 IP 与鸿蒙生态的一次结合，也延续了 QQ 宠物接入大模型后向 AI 陪伴方向演进的路线。
items.why_en: It pairs a classic Tencent IP with the HarmonyOS ecosystem, continuing QQ Pet's evolution toward AI-driven companionship after integrating Tencent's large model.

items.why_en: ByteDance's Doubao model moving into car cockpits signals that AI assistants are becoming a new battleground for automaker differentiation.

items.title_zh: Meta 公布“Hologram”全新拟真虚拟形象，今年秋季陆续上线雷朋 Display 智能眼镜 / 全新轻薄型头显
items.title_en: Meta Unveils 'Hologram' Photorealistic Avatars for Ray-Ban Display Glasses and New Lightweight Headset
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 28 日消息，Meta 宣布将于今年秋季起陆续为旗下雷朋 Display 智能眼镜 / Quest 头显及全新轻薄型头显上线“Hologram”全新虚拟形象功能，这项技术类似苹果 Vision Pro 的 Persona，能够通过生成式 AI 打造与真人外观高度接近的虚拟形象。 事实上，Meta 早在 7 年前就展示了名为 Codec Avatars 的拟真虚拟形象项目，不过目前消费者可以买到的 Meta VR 产品仍主要使用较为卡通化的自定义形象角色。按照目前的规划，后续 Meta 会逐步将用户的自定义形象角色从卡通化转向拟真写实化。 据介绍，用户首次使用 Hologram 时，需要打开手机上的 Meta AI 应用，并按照提示转动头部、微笑等。随后系统会提出一些开放式问题，用户需要进行较长时间的回答。在回答过程中，系统会采集用户的面部表情和说话状态，用于训练和调整 Hologram 模型，同时还会记录用户的服装和背景。 整个创建过程只需几分钟，完成服务器端处理后即可生成 Hologram。之后，当用户佩戴 Meta 雷朋 Display 眼镜接听或拨打 WhatsApp 视频电话时， 对方看到的将不再是传统摄像头画面，而是由 AI 生成的用户面部虚拟形象 。 从技术角度来看，Meta 雷朋 Display 版本的 Hologram 采用运行在 Meta 服务器…
items.summary_en: Meta says its new 'Hologram' photorealistic avatar feature, similar in concept to Apple's Vision Pro Persona, will roll out this fall to Ray-Ban Display glasses, Quest headsets and a new lightweight headset. Users create an avatar in minutes via the Meta AI phone app by turning their head, smiling and answering open-ended questions, and WhatsApp video calls made through the glasses will then show the AI-generated face instead of a camera feed.
items.why_zh: 这是 Meta 将实验室级写实数字人技术推向消费级硬件的重要一步，可能重塑视频通话与元宇宙中的身份呈现方式。
items.why_en: It marks a major step in bringing lab-grade photorealistic avatars to consumer hardware, potentially reshaping identity representation in video calls and the metaverse.

items.title_zh: 特朗普与 Anthropic 亿万富翁 CEO 达里奥·阿莫代伊共进晚餐

items.summary_en: Trump Has Dinner With Anthropic’s Billionaire CEO Dario Amodei After Earlier Barbs Forbes

items.title_zh: 荣耀 WKL-AN80 新机现身安兔兔：第 6 代骁龙 8 超级至尊版、跑分超 552 万，预计是 Magic9 Pro Max
