items.why_zh: 跑分曝光提前揭示了新一代安卓旗舰的性能上限与荣耀旗舰的规格方向，是观察高端手机芯片竞争的重要信号。
items.why_en: The leaked benchmark hints at the performance ceiling of the next-generation Android flagship and signals how high-end phone chip competition is shaping up.

items.title_zh: Atelier：用超网络为冷冻电镜体数据学习局部自监督特征
items.title_en: Atelier: Learning Local Self-Supervised Features for CryoEM Volumes via Hypernetworks
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文关注冷冻电镜（CryoEM）图谱解读所需特征应具备的三个性质：空间局部化、跨样本一致以及跨空间尺度有信息量。多数用于图谱标注的深度学习方法从固定体素网格中提取特征，而隐式神经表示（INR）能把体数据建模为与尺度无关、以坐标为条件的函数，因此对冷冻电镜颇具吸引力。但为每张图谱单独拟合一个 INR 代价过高，不适合大规模特征提取，且所得表示在样本之间并不对齐。论文提出名为 Atelier 的方法，借助超网络（hypernetworks）来应对这一问题；摘要公开部分在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30569v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CryoEM map interpretation requires features that are spatially localized, consistent across samples, and informative across spatial scales. Most deep learning methods for map annotation extract features from fixed voxel grids. However, implicit neural representations (INRs) are able to model volumetric data as scale-agnostic, coordinate-conditioned functions. INRs are therefore attractive for cryoEM, but fitting a separate INR for each map is too expensive for large-scale feature extraction and produces representations that are not aligned across…
items.why_zh: 若成立，该方法可在不逐图重训的前提下为冷冻电镜提供统一、可复用的自监督特征，有助于结构生物学的规模化分析。
items.why_en: If it works, it could provide unified, reusable self-supervised features for cryoEM without per-map retraining, aiding large-scale structural biology analysis.

items.title_zh: HARDEN：用受约束的进化搜索生成更难但不改变答案的评测样本
items.title_en: HARDEN: Constrained Evolutionary Search for Harder, Answer-Preserving Evaluation Cases
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，语言模型常在精心整理的基准上评测，而这些基准难以覆盖企业级部署的真实复杂度。作者提出 HARDEN——一种受约束的进化搜索方法，把已有评测用例的输入改写为更具挑战性的变体，同时保持其期望输出不变。搜索沿着生成的领域特定复杂度轴推进，并施加可行性约束，例如保持任务语义、现实性与执行有效性。方法在 FinQA、PubMedQA、ContractNLI 以及三种规模（含 35B）的 Qwen3.5 模型上进行了验证；摘要公开部分在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models are often evaluated on curated benchmarks that underrepresent the complexity of enterprise deployments. We introduce HARDEN, a constrained evolutionary search method to adapt the input of existing evaluation cases into more challenging variants while keeping their expected outputs fixed. HARDEN searches along generated domain-specific complexity axes while enforcing feasibility constraints such as preserving task semantics, realism, and execution validity. Across FinQA, PubMedQA, and ContractNLI and three Qwen3.5 model scales (35B…
items.why_zh: 在不改动标准答案的前提下自动加难度，有望让基准更贴近真实企业负载，暴露模型被高估的鲁棒性短板。
items.why_en: Automatically hardening benchmarks without changing ground truth could make evaluations better reflect real enterprise workloads and expose overestimated model robustness.

items.title_zh: 音频大模型能察觉自己“听不清”吗？研究发现它们并不擅长自我判断
items.title_en: Audio LLMs Know When They Can't Hear You
items.summary_zh: 论文研究音频大语言模型的“模型条件化转写可靠性”问题：当输入录音质量过差时，模型可能误解用户问询并基于错误的转写作答，那么模型能否识别出自己的转写不可靠？作者先让音频大模型自行评估其转写是否可靠，结果发现模型对自身转写可靠性的判断能力很差，多数情况下其预测并不准确。摘要公开部分在此处截断，后续提出的改进方法未完整披露。该研究指向语音交互系统在噪声、退化音频场景下的可靠性风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Audio large language models allow users to interact with the model through speech. When an input recording is too degraded, the model may misinterpret the user's query and respond based on an incorrect transcription. In this paper, we study model-conditional transcription reliability: whether an Audio LLM can recognize when its own transcription is unreliable. We first prompt the Audio LLM to assess whether its own transcription would be reliable, and find that the model is a poor judge of its own transcription reliability: in most cases, it pred…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了语音交互中一个被忽视的失效模式——模型在听不清时仍自信作答，是提升音频大模型可靠性的关键课题。
items.why_en: It exposes an overlooked failure mode in voice interfaces—confidently answering despite mishearing—a key issue for making audio LLMs more reliable.

items.title_zh: 思考的代价：推理算力在 LLM 交易中真的划算吗？
items.title_en: The Price of Thought: Does Test-Time Reasoning Pay in LLM Trading?
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，虽然大模型的推理期思考（test-time reasoning）有望带来更好的决策，但其更高的计算成本未必转化为更好的经济结果；而推理控制很少被当作经济干预来评估——即模型输出的改变必须扣除交易成本后仍能改善投资组合。作者对 DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini 系列的多个代表性模型做了对照实验，在固定每个建仓日可获得的信息、提示词、输出格式与组合约束的前提下，改变推理投入强度。摘要公开部分在此处截断，具体结论未完整披露。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30705v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While inference-time reasoning in large language models (LLMs) promises better decision making, its higher computational cost may not yield better economic outcomes. Yet reasoning controls are rarely evaluated as economic interventions, where changes in model outputs must translate into better portfolios after trading costs. We conduct a controlled study of representative LLMs from the DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini families. We vary reasoning effort while holding information available at each formation date, prompts, output formats, and portfolio con…
items.why_zh: 它把“思考更多是否更值钱”从能力问题转为成本收益问题，为金融等高风险场景的推理算力投入提供评估框架。
items.why_en: It reframes 'does more thinking pay' as a cost-benefit question, offering a framework for judging reasoning compute budgets in high-stakes settings like finance.

items.title_zh: 从 S3Q 理论到实现：迈向机器感质（Qualia）的架构
items.title_en: From S3Q Theory to Implementation: Towards an Architecture for Machine Qualia
items.summary_zh: 机器意识研究的一大难题，是如何把理论模型真正落到可计算实现层面。这篇论文针对 S3Q（Simulated、Situated、Structurally Coherent，即模拟、情境化、结构一致）意识理论，提出一个五层实现架构。该架构并不引入新的形式化工具，而是把已有公开发表的计算原语组合成一条完整流水线。S3Q 理论认为感质（qualia）需要三个共同必要条件，摘要中明确列出的包括基于身体的感觉运动情境性以及内部模拟能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key challenge in machine consciousness research is translating theoretical models into computational-level implementations. In this paper, we address this challenge by proposing a five-layer implementation architecture for the S3Q (Simulated, Situated, Structurally Coherent) theory of consciousness. Rather than introducing novel formalisms, the architecture composes published computational primitives into a single pipeline. S3Q identifies three jointly necessary conditions for qualia: (1) grounded sensorimotor situatedness, (2) internal simulat…
items.why_zh: 它为抽象的机器意识理论提供了可落地的工程化路线，让意识研究更易被检验和复现。
items.why_en: It offers a concrete engineering route for abstract machine-consciousness theories, making them easier to test and reproduce.

items.title_zh: ORCA：评估大模型的数据科学代码翻译能力
items.title_en: ORCA: Evaluating LLMs on Data Science Code Translation
items.summary_zh: 数据科学代码翻译（DSCT）指在不同数据科学库之间转换代码，同时保持功能等价、实现生态互操作。尽管大模型在数据科学代码生成（DSCG）上已有明显进展，但其在代码翻译上的表现仍缺乏系统研究。为填补这一空白，作者提出综合基准 ORCA，包含两种互补设置：其中 ORCA-MAIN 覆盖 1,600 个精心筛选的 grounding 级任务等。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data Science Code Translation (DSCT) is the process of converting code between data science libraries while preserving functional equivalence and enabling interoperability across data science ecosystems. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable progress in Data Science Code Generation (DSCG), their performance in DSCT remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce ORCA, a comprehensive benchmark with two complementary settings: ORCA-MAIN, which comprises 1,600 carefully curated grounding-level tasks acr…
items.why_zh: 它填补了大模型跨数据科学库代码翻译评测的空白，有助于衡量模型在真实数据工程场景中的可用性。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in benchmarking LLM code translation across data science libraries, helping gauge real-world usefulness.

items.title_zh: BAER：面向鲁棒两两 LLM 评判的骨干自适应证据路由
items.title_en: Backbone-Adaptive Evidence Routing for Robust Pairwise LLM Judging
items.summary_zh: 成对语言模型评判可以通过直接比较、推理或基于参考的验证来收集证据，但没有任何单一协议在所有基准和评判骨干模型上都最优。为此作者提出骨干自适应证据路由（BAER），在保持候选对称性的前提下自适应选择证据机制——交换两个回答可能逆转偏好方向，但不会改变偏好强度。BAER 将每位专家的带符号偏好与候选无关的可靠性分离，并构建了证据堆叠、可靠性等三个对称头。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pairwise language-model judges can gather evidence through direct comparison, reasoning, or reference-based verification, but no single protocol is best across benchmarks and judge backbones. We introduce Backbone-Adaptive Evidence Routing (BAER), which adapts the evidence mechanism while preserving candidate symmetry: swapping the two responses may reverse the preference but cannot change its strength. BAER separates each expert's signed preference from candidate-invariant reliability and builds three symmetric heads: evidence stacking, reliabil…
items.why_zh: 它为 LLM-as-a-judge 提供了更稳健、与模型无关的评判方案，有助于减少评判偏差。
items.why_en: It makes LLM-as-a-judge evaluation more robust and backbone-agnostic, helping reduce judging bias.

items.title_zh: 保险准备金智能平台
items.title_en: Insurance Reserve Intelligence Platform
items.summary_zh: 准备金估算是支撑保费定价、偿付能力评估、财务报告、资本规划与风险管理的核心精算任务。基于 Thiele 微分方程的经典准备金方法严谨且可解释，但在敏感性分析、优化和大规模情景评估中，反复计算会变得非常昂贵。本文提出一个面向定期寿险准备金建模的保险准备金智能平台，以应对这一计算瓶颈。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Insurance reserve estimation is a fundamental actuarial task supporting premium pricing, solvency assessment, financial reporting, capital planning, and risk management. Classical reserve methods based on Thiele's differential equation provide a rigorous and interpretable foundation for life insurance valuation, but repeated reserve calculations become computationally expensive in sensitivity analysis, optimization, and large-scale scenario evaluation. This paper presents an Insurance Reserve Intelligence Platform for term-life reserve modelling…
items.why_zh: 它把经典精算方法与智能平台结合，有望在保持可解释性的同时提升大规模准备金计算效率。
items.why_en: It combines classical actuarial methods with an intelligent platform, potentially boosting large-scale reserve computation while keeping interpretability.

items.title_zh: ConsultMind：面向不确定性感知推理的自动化诊断问诊
items.title_en: ConsultMind:Towards Automated Diagnostic Consultation via Uncertainty-Aware Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 诊断问诊是一个在线的序贯决策过程，医生通过与患者互动不断收集证据，直到诊断获得足够支持。要自动化这一过程，需要自适应提问和可解释的决策。贝叶斯网络能在证据累积时更新诊断后验，是天然的基础，但用于开放式问诊面临两大挑战：如何把诊断假设与潜在问询相连接，以及如何将不断变化的信念转化为问诊决策。作者据此提出了 ConsultMind 方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30796v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diagnostic consultation is an online sequential decision-making process in which clinicians gather evidence through patient interaction until a diagnosis is sufficiently supported. Automating this process requires adaptive inquiry and interpretable decisions. Bayesian networks offer a natural foundation by updating diagnostic posteriors as evidence accumulates, but their use in open-ended consultation raises two challenges: linking diagnostic hypotheses to potential inquiries and translating evolving posteriors into consultation decisions. We int…
items.why_zh: 它探索以不确定性感知推理驱动自动问诊，为可解释的临床辅助决策提供新思路。
items.why_en: It explores uncertainty-aware reasoning for automated consultation, offering a path toward interpretable clinical decision support.

items.title_zh: 评估实时语音智能体：从组件质量到有依据的结果
items.title_en: Evaluating Real-Time Voice Agents: From Component Quality to Grounded Outcomes
items.summary_zh: 实时语音智能体已从研究原型走向生产部署，但描述它们的文献分散在三个很少相互引用的社区中：语音基础建模、话轮转换心理语言学与智能体评测。架构论文报告延迟，话轮研究报告预测准确率，智能体基准报告任务成功率，因此没有任何一个单一数字能说明已部署的智能体到底好不好。作者针对这一缺口提出三项有证据支撑的主张，每项都可追溯到一个语料库。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time voice agents have moved from research prototypes to production deployments, yet the literature describing them is fragmented across three communities that rarely cite one another: speech foundation modelling, turn-taking psycholinguistics, and agentic evaluation. Architecture papers report latency, turn-taking papers report prediction accuracy, and agentic benchmarks report task success, so no single number describes whether a deployed agent is actually good. We address that gap with three evidence-based claims, each traceable to a corp…
items.why_zh: 它指出现有语音智能体评测体系的割裂，并尝试给出更统一的评估框架，对产品落地具有指导意义。
items.why_en: It highlights the fragmentation of voice-agent evaluation and proposes a more unified framework with practical value.

items.title_zh: 共享智能体记忆中认知准入的基准与诊断研究
items.title_en: A Benchmark and Diagnostic Study of Epistemic Admission in Shared Agent Memory
items.summary_zh: 评估共享智能体记忆中的主张准入之所以困难，是因为重复出现的说法可能被误当作独立证据：智能体可能复制或转述检索到的信念，而一旦纳入虚假主张，后续智能体也会暴露其中。为研究这一问题，作者提出相关促进基准（CPB），用于评估候选主张是否应被写入共享记忆。其中 CPB-Static 基于公开标注来源构建固定测试集与固定的金标准动作，CPB-Live 则在共享存储上运行多智能体团队。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30813v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating claim admission in shared agent memory is challenging because repeated claims may be mistaken for independent evidence. An agent may copy or paraphrase a retrieved belief, while admitting a false claim exposes subsequent agents to it. To study this problem, we introduce the Correlated Promotion Benchmark (CPB), which evaluates whether candidate claims should be admitted to shared memory.CPB-Static constructs a frozen test split from publicly annotated sources with fixed gold actions. CPB-Live runs multi-agent teams over a shared store,…
items.why_zh: 它为多智能体记忆的可靠性设立评测标准，关系到智能体群体是否会传播错误信息。
items.why_en: It sets a benchmark for the reliability of multi-agent memory, addressing whether agent collectives amplify false claims.

items.title_zh: SkillEvoReg：正则化智能体技能演化以防过拟合
items.title_en: SkillEvoReg: Regularizing Agent Skill Evolution Against Overfitting
items.summary_zh: 语言模型智能体越来越多地通过把执行经验转化为可复用的外部技能来提升能力。但反复的技能更新本身构成一种学习过程：局部有用的编辑可能累积成冗余或任务专用指令，而新的更新也可能破坏此前有效的行为。作者将这一问题称为“技能演化过拟合”，并提出 SkillEvoReg——一个受神经网络抗过拟合技术启发、面向技能演化的通用正则化框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly improve by converting execution experience into reusable external skills. Yet repeated skill updates form a learning process of their own: locally useful edits can accumulate into redundant or task-specific instructions, while new updates can disrupt behavior that previously worked. We study this problem as skill-evolution overfitting and introduce SkillEvoReg, a general regularization framework for skill evolution inspired by anti-overfitting techniques in neural-network training. SkillEvoReg combines training-…
items.why_zh: 它把持续技能更新中的“过拟合/遗忘”问题正式化，为智能体长期自我改进提供稳定机制。
items.why_en: It formalizes overfitting in continual skill updates, offering a mechanism for stable long-term agent self-improvement.

items.title_zh: 在网页图上训练图基础模型 Acacia
items.title_en: Training Graph Foundation Models on The Web Graph
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出图基础模型 Acacia，直接在大规模网页图上进行训练。据摘要，Acacia 无需额外训练即可支持任意维度和语义的节点特征，也能覆盖节点分类、链接预测、节点聚类和图生成等多种任务，并具备上下文学习（in-context learning）能力。与许多现有图基础模型不同，它不依赖预训练的大语言模型，也不需要为适配新任务再训练额外的分类头或特征投影器。该工作为构建通用、可迁移的图模型提供了一条不依赖 LLM 的技术路线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Acacia, a graph foundation model, trained on the web graph. Acacia (i) supports arbitrary feature dimensionalities and semantics without additional training, (ii) supports a wide range of tasks, including node classification, link prediction, node clustering, and graph generation, without additional training, (iii) has in-context learning capabilities, and (iv) does not rely on pretrained LLMs. In particular, existing graph foundation models often require training additional classification heads or feature projectors to accommodate n…
items.why_zh: 它展示了不依赖大语言模型、无需任务微调即可通用的图基础模型路线，可能改变图学习领域的建模范式。
items.why_en: It demonstrates a general-purpose graph foundation model that needs neither LLMs nor task-specific fine-tuning, potentially shifting how graph learning models are built.

items.title_zh: 同样的文本，不同的数字：LLM 文本度量的分歧
items.title_en: Same Text, Different Numbers: The Divergence of LLM-Based Measures
items.summary_zh: 越来越多研究者用生成式大模型把公司文本转成实证变量，但一项新研究检验了这类度量对模型选择的敏感程度。作者选取情感、管理层表述清晰度、不确定性、回答具体性以及气候与政治风险等 13 项度量，让来自不同厂商的 7 个 LLM 为标普 500 公司的财报电话会议记录打分。结果显示，跨模型的排序相关性平均仅为 0.52，且不同厂商的模型在单份记录层面存在系统性差异。这说明基于 LLM 的文本度量并不稳定，模型选择本身就可能影响研究结论，使用时应格外谨慎并报告稳健性检验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Researchers increasingly use generative large language models (LLMs) to convert corporate text into empirical variables. We examine the extent to which LLM-based textual measures are invariant to model choice using thirteen measures, including sentiment, management clarity, uncertainty, answer specificity, and climate and political risk. Seven LLMs from different providers score earnings call transcripts of S&P 500 companies on these constructs. Cross-model rank correlations average only 0.52, and transcript-level differences common across provid…
items.why_zh: 它用实证数据说明 LLM 生成的文本指标跨模型并不一致，提醒依赖此类变量的研究警惕可复现性问题。
items.why_en: It empirically shows that LLM-derived text measures are not invariant across models, warning researchers about reproducibility risks in such variables.

items.title_zh: 廉价开源智能体让 LLM 数据污染更难防范
items.title_en: Cheap, open agents make LLM pollution harder to mitigate
items.summary_zh: 所谓 LLM 污染，是指合成回答混入本应反映真实人类行为的数据中。此前自主问卷智能体因部署成本高昂，风险相对有限；但论文指出，开放权重模型搭配开源智能体框架可能已消除这一门槛。作者比较了 9 种智能体配置，从完全开源的方案到闭源商用方案，让每个智能体自主完成一份包含多种题型、可用于多种检测手段的问卷。研究关注这些配置的表现与可检测性，提示调查数据的可信度正面临更廉价、更易复制的自动化污染威胁。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) pollution occurs when synthetic responses contaminate data intended to capture human behavior. High deployment costs have so far limited the risk posed by autonomous survey agents. However, open-weight models paired with open-source agentic frameworks may have removed this barrier. We compared the performance and detectability of nine agent configurations, ranging from fully open variants to closed commercial ones. Each agent autonomously completed a survey containing multiple response types yielding various detection c…
items.why_zh: 它揭示低成本开源智能体可能大规模污染人类行为数据，动摇问卷与调查类研究的可信基础。
items.why_en: It reveals that cheap open agents could widely contaminate human-behavior data, undermining the credibility of survey-based research.

items.title_zh: 外化 CPDAG 摘要提升 LLM 因果推断能力
items.title_en: Externalized CPDAG Summaries Improve LLM Causal Deduction
items.summary_zh: Corr2Cause 任务要求判断某个因果主张是否在所有与观测相关性和条件独立性相符的有向无环图中成立。论文将其视为潜在对象推理：标签由 CPDAG 查询定义，而自由形式的思维链往往把马尔可夫等价类问题退化为局部模式匹配。为此作者提出 Structured Thinking 两轮流程，先外化出一份带类型、受模式约束的 CPDAG 摘要，再基于该图状态作答。在 Corr2Cause 完整测试集上，这一方法提升了 Qwen3.5-27B 的表现，表明显式结构化中间表示有助于大模型的因果推理。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Corr2Cause asks whether a causal claim holds in every DAG compatible with observed correlations and conditional independencies. We frame this as latent-object reasoning: the label is defined by a CPDAG query, but free-form chain-of-thought often collapses the Markov-equivalence-class problem into local pattern matching. We propose Structured Thinking, a two-turn pipeline that first externalizes a typed, schema-constrained CPDAG summary and then answers against that graph state. On the Corr2Cause full test, Structured Thinking raises Qwen3.5-27B f…
items.why_zh: 它说明把隐式的图结构显式外化，能显著改善大模型在因果推断这类需要全局推理任务上的表现。
items.why_en: It shows that externalizing latent graph structure can markedly improve LLM performance on causal tasks requiring global reasoning.

items.title_zh: 面向代码仓库问题定位的语义导航
items.title_en: Semantic Navigation for Issue Localization in Code Repository
items.summary_zh: 仓库级问题定位的目标是找出并排序与解决某个已报告 issue 相关的文件和函数。LLM 智能体通常以迭代方式完成该任务：先提出可能的候选位置，再查看对应代码，并随着新证据修正判断。论文指出，现有环境对这一循环的支持有限——智能体必须自行搜索尚未解析的关系目标、从原始源码重建实体语义，并在缺乏证据支撑的情况下修改候选。该工作据此提出语义导航方案，以更好地支撑代码仓库中的问题定位。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Repository-level issue localization aims to identify and rank the files and functions relevant to resolving a reported issue. LLM agents approach this task iteratively: they identify a set of potentially relevant locations, inspect the corresponding code, and revise their judgments about these candidates as new evidence is acquired. Existing environments, however, provide limited support for this loop: agents must search for unresolved relation targets, reconstruct entity semantics from raw source code, and revise candidates without evidential ba…
items.why_zh: 它针对 LLM 智能体在真实代码仓库中定位问题时的环境支持短板，有望提升自动化缺陷修复的准确度。
items.why_en: It addresses a key environment gap for LLM agents localizing issues in real repositories, potentially improving automated bug fixing.

items.title_zh: 递归自我改进 AI 的演化安全：分类、风险发现与评估
items.title_en: Evolutionary Safety of Recursive Self-Improving AI: Taxonomy, Risk Discovery, and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 系统在推理、决策、科学发现和自主开发中承担越来越大的角色，AI 开始参与自身的改进——从模型训练、经验积累到智能体演化和自动化 AI 开发，递归自我改进（RSI）的前景日益现实。论文提出一个根本性安全问题：当系统本身、其积累的经验乃至改进机制都在持续变化时，如何维持安全。作者围绕这一主题构建了分类体系，进行风险发现并提出评估方法，为 RSI 场景下的安全研究提供框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence is advancing rapidly, with increasingly capable systems taking larger roles in reasoning, decision-making, scientific discovery, and autonomous development. As AI begins to participate in its own improvement, from model training and experience accumulation to agent evolution and automated AI development, the prospect of recursive self-improvement (RSI) is becoming increasingly relevant. This transition raises a fundamental safety question: how can safety be maintained when the system, its accumulated experience, and even t…
items.why_zh: 它为递归自我改进这一潜在高风险方向提供了系统的风险分类与评估框架，有助于提前布局 AI 安全治理。
items.why_en: It offers a systematic taxonomy and evaluation framework for recursive self-improvement, helping anticipate governance needs for a potentially high-risk direction.

items.title_zh: DIAL：位置去偏并自适应校准人类偏好的 LLM 评判器
items.title_en: DIAL: Position-Debiased LLM Judges with Adaptive Human Preference Calibration
items.summary_zh: 用大模型充当评判者可以实现规模化评估，但其判断可能受回答顺序影响；即便消除位置效应，评判结果仍可能系统性地偏离人类偏好。论文提出统一框架 DIAL，把大量 LLM 比较与有限的人类比较结合起来：分离出评判器特有的位置效应，学习去偏后 LLM 偏好中的共享结构，并将该结构自适应地校准到人类偏好目标上。作者还从理论层面研究了该框架的三个相关性质，试图在低成本与贴近人类判断之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) as a judge enable scalable evaluation, but their judgments can be sensitive to response order and, even after removing such position effects, can still diverge systematically from human preferences.We introduce DIAL, a unified framework that combines abundant LLM comparisons with limited human comparisons to separate judge-specific position effects, learn shared structure in position-debiased LLM preferences, and adaptively calibrate that structure toward the human preference target. Theoretically, we study three aspe…
items.why_zh: 它试图在保持规模化评估效率的同时，让 LLM 评判结果更贴近真实人类偏好，提升评测可信度。
items.why_en: It aims to keep evaluation scalable while making LLM judgments align more closely with true human preferences, improving evaluation credibility.

items.title_zh: 信息抽取流水线的选择取决于文档：小型本地模型的精度—能耗权衡
items.title_en: The Right Information Extraction Pipeline Depends on the Document: Accuracy-Energy Trade-offs for Small, Local Models
items.summary_zh: 信息抽取流水线该处理页面图像还是解析后的文本，取决于文档本身，而且答案会随版式谱系翻转。论文在排除闭源云服务的约束下研究这一权衡：由参数不超过 8B 的小型纯文本模型和视觉语言模型在本地处理隐私敏感文档，并在输入表示、模型家族和推理配置构成的设计空间中同时评估准确率与能耗。作者在接近纯文本的 Kleister-NDA 数据集等基准上进行了测试，说明并不存在普遍最优的抽取方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether an information extraction pipeline should process page images or parsed text depends on the document, and the answer flips across the layout spectrum. We study this trade-off under a constraint that rules out (closed) cloud services: privacy-sensitive documents processed on-premise by small ($\le 8\mathrm{B}$ parameter) text-only and vision--language models, evaluated on both accuracy and energy over a design space spanning input representation, model family, and inference configuration. Benchmarking on the near-plain-text Kleister-NDA co…
items.why_zh: 它为在本地部署、兼顾隐私与能耗的信息抽取给出了具体权衡证据，提醒实践者按文档类型选方案。
items.why_en: It provides concrete accuracy-energy trade-off evidence for privacy-preserving on-premise extraction, reminding practitioners to choose pipelines per document type.

items.title_zh: 完成配对掩盖了触顶失败：ReVerPi 选择性上下文投影案例研究
items.title_en: Completed Pairs Hide Capped Failures: A ReVerPi Case Study of Selective Context Projection
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨“上下文投影”的权衡：用紧凑、可寻址的摘录替换较早的工具观察结果，以减少重复输入，但可能增加证据检索轮次。作者在 ReVerPi（Pi 的扩展，具备归档观察与配对的完整/投影续写）上开展实验，包含 86 次运行、641 次模型请求。结果显示，15 个“完成配对”的成功率完全一致，每组均为 12/15；另有 12 次边界运行中止，原因是运行器在第一个臂未完成时会抑制配对臂。摘要提到恢复全部 27 个边界运行（原文在此处截断），提示仅统计完成配对可能系统性地掩盖失败。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Context projection replaces older tool observations with compact, addressable excerpts, reducing repeated input while potentially adding evidence-retrieval turns. We study this trade-off in ReVerPi, a Pi extension with archived observations and matched full/projected continuations. In an 86-run source-reading campaign with 641 model requests, the 15 completed pairs show identical success: 12/15 per arm. Twelve further boundary runs stop, with the runner suppressing the companion whenever the first arm fails to complete. Restoring all 27 boundary…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了评测中的选择性偏差：只统计“完成配对”会掩盖被截断的失败，可能高估上下文压缩等效率方法的真实收益。
items.why_en: It exposes a selection bias in evaluation: counting only completed pairs hides truncated failures and can overstate the real benefits of efficiency methods such as context projection.

items.title_zh: Game Arena：在竞争性环境中评估 LLM 的战略能力
items.title_en: Game Arena: Strategic LLM Evaluation in Competitive Environments
items.summary_zh: 论文介绍 Kaggle Game Arena，一个开放且持续扩展的平台，通过竞争性游戏评测大语言模型。与静态基准不同，它让模型在结构化环境中正面对弈，随着模型进化，游戏强度自然提升，从而避免性能饱和。技术报告详述了平台背后的基础设施，并描述了三个试点游戏环境：国际象棋、扑克和狼人杀。这些环境覆盖完美信息与不完美信息等不同博弈类型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Kaggle Game Arena, an open and ever-expanding platform to evaluate large language models (LLMs) through competitive games. Different from static benchmarks, game arena enables models to play head-to-head matchups in structured environments where the gameplay strength naturally increases as models evolve, preventing performance saturation. This technical report details the infrastructure behind Game Arena and describes the three pilot game environments: Chess, Poker, and Werewolf. These environments span perfect information, imperfect…
items.why_zh: 动态对抗式评测有望缓解静态基准很快饱和、难以区分模型真实能力的问题。
items.why_en: Dynamic, adversarial evaluation could mitigate static benchmarks' saturation and better distinguish models' true capabilities.

items.title_zh: 冻结 BERT 中 AI 文本检测神经元的机制研究：RAID 上的稀疏探针与激活修补
items.title_en: A Mechanistic Study of AI-Text Detection Neurons in Frozen BERT: Sparse Probing and Activation Patching on RAID
items.summary_zh: AI 生成文本检测器在标准基准上准确率很高，但其内部表征仍不清楚。研究考察冻结的 BERT-base-uncased 编码器中哪些神经元支撑 AI 文本检测，使用 RAID 基准，覆盖六个生成器（含纯基础模型与指令微调模型）。作者把 Gurnee 等人（2023）的 L1-to-L2 稀疏探针协议应用于全部 9,216 个 CLS 隐藏状态维度（12 层 × 768），并将这些维度称为“神经元”。该流程恢复出一个稳定的、占比不足 1% 的集合，并结合激活修补进行验证（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30287v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-generated text detectors achieve high accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet the internal representations that drive these predictions remain poorly understood. We study which neurons in a frozen BERT-base-uncased encoder support AI-text detection, using the RAID benchmark across six generators spanning pure-base and instruction-tuned models. We apply the L1-to-L2 sparse-probing protocol of Gurnee et al. (2023) to all 9,216 CLS hidden-state dimensions (12 layers x 768), which we call neurons. The procedure recovers a stable set of under 1% of…
items.why_zh: 理解检测器依赖哪些内部神经元，有助于评估其鲁棒性，并设计更难被规避的 AI 文本检测方法。
items.why_en: Understanding which internal neurons detectors rely on can inform robustness and the design of harder-to-evade AI-text detection.

items.title_zh: SlideLab：以观众为中心的科学幻灯片生成与评估
items.title_en: SlideLab: Audience-Centered Scientific Slide Generation and Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 科学演示不只是论文的摘要，还需要连贯的叙事顺序、清晰解释核心思想，并帮助观众跟上讲述。作者提出 SlideLab，一个无需训练的多智能体框架，可把研究论文转成科学演示。它先规划演讲叙事，再通过内容规划、视觉生成、版式精修和依据核验等智能体，构建并迭代优化共享的幻灯片。摘要提到一项盲测人类偏好评估（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30294v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scientific presentations are more than summaries of research papers. They need to present the work in a coherent sequence, explain the main ideas clearly, and help the audience follow the presentation. We present SlideLab, a training-free multi-agent framework for generating scientific presentations from research papers. SlideLab first plans the presentation narrative, then builds and iteratively refines a shared slide deck using agents for content planning, visual generation, layout refinement, and grounding verification. In a blind human pref…
items.why_zh: 它把多智能体协作从文本生成推进到需要叙事、视觉与事实核验的复杂文档创作，并给出以观众为中心的评测思路。
items.why_en: It pushes multi-agent collaboration beyond text generation into complex document creation requiring narrative, visuals, and factual grounding, with audience-centered evaluation.

items.title_zh: 仅靠编程智能体还不够！评估用于智能体式云调查的企业安全大脑
items.title_en: Coding Agents Aren't Enough! Evaluating an Enterprise Security Brain for Agentic Cloud Investigations
items.summary_zh: 云安全调查主要由“群体性任务”主导：哪些身份能读取某个数据存储、多少资源未通过某项控制、哪些资产可从另一个账户访问等。这些问题必须对照完整清单来回答，而不是针对某个具名对象；只回答一部分并不等于部分结果，而是另一种结果。如今通用编程智能体可被授予只读云凭证并直接开展调查，这引出一个问题：专门构建的安全上下文层还能贡献什么。作者评估了 Sola S…（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30345v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cloud-security investigation is dominated by population tasks: which identities can read a data store, how many resources fail a control, which assets are reachable from another account. These resolve against a complete inventory, not a named object. A partial answer to one is not a partial result. It is a different result. General-purpose coding agents can now be given read-only cloud credentials and asked to investigate directly, which raises the question of what a purpose-built security context layer still contributes. We evaluate the Sola S…
items.why_zh: 它质疑了“给编程智能体只读云权限就能做安全调查”的乐观设想，凸显专门安全上下文层的必要性。
items.why_en: It challenges the assumption that coding agents with read-only cloud access suffice for security investigation, highlighting the value of a purpose-built security context layer.

items.title_zh: 基于成对反馈的成本感知最佳 LLM 识别
items.title_en: Cost-Aware Best-LLM Identification using Dueling Feedback
items.summary_zh: 论文关注的问题是：如何在查询成本各异的一组大语言模型中找出最佳模型。作者提出并分析多臂老虎机（MAB）的一个变体，同时具备两个特点：一是“对抗式（成对）反馈”，即通过模型回答的两两比较获得稳健的偏好信号；二是异质采样成本，反映查询不同 LLM 的代价差异。研究假设存在孔多塞赢家，并在多个真实数据集上对该假设进行了实证验证，进而提出一种算法（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30360v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inspired by the problem of identifying the best model from a collection of large language models (LLMs) with heterogeneous querying costs, we formulate and analyse a variant of the multi-armed bandit (MAB) with (i) dueling feedback, where pairwise comparisons between model responses provide robust preference signals, and (ii) heterogeneous sampling costs, reflecting the differing costs of querying different LLMs. Assuming the existence of a Condorcet winner, a condition we empirically validate across multiple real-world datasets, we propose a T…
items.why_zh: 它把模型评测与选择形式化为带成本的成对比较问题，有助于在预算有限时更高效地选出最优模型。
items.why_en: It formalizes best-model selection as a cost-aware dueling-bandit problem, enabling more efficient identification of the best LLM under limited budget.

items.title_zh: 什么能提升多模态虚假信息检测？一项大规模实证研究的答案
items.title_en: What Improves Multimodal Misinformation Detection? Answers from a Large-Scale Empirical Study
items.summary_zh: 多模态虚假信息越来越多地通过“文字主张 + 看似佐证的图片”来增强说服力。然而在实践中，构建有效检测器往往取决于少数很少被系统检验的设计选择。本文开展大规模研究，考察多模态虚假信息检测的设计选择，进行了超过 3,375 次实验，覆盖三个基准数据集以及广泛的预训练视觉与语言骨干模型。通过系统比较与针对性分析（原文在此处截断），研究旨在厘清哪些设计真正带来提升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30402v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multimodal misinformation is increasingly crafted to look convincing by pairing a textual claim with an image that appears to "prove" it. Yet in practice, building effective detectors often hinges on a small set of design choices that are rarely examined in a controlled way. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale study of multimodal design choices for misinformation detection with over 3,375 experiments- spanning three benchmark datasets and a broad range of pre-trained vision and language backbones. Through systematic comparisons and targeted…
items.why_zh: 它为多模态虚假信息检测提供了规模可观的受控证据，帮助研究者分辨哪些设计选择真正有效。
items.why_en: It provides large-scale controlled evidence on which multimodal design choices genuinely improve misinformation detection.

items.title_zh: 面向上下文感知 XR 界面的基准测试框架
items.title_en: A Benchmarking Framework for Context-aware XR Interfaces
items.summary_zh: 日常扩展现实（XR）系统希望用户切换情境时，能在恰当的时间与地点提供恰当功能，且尽量无需手动重配置。但此类界面难以评估：现有的原型与用户研究流程无法系统、可重复地比较不同用户与场景下的适配方法。作者提出 ContextXR，一个面向上下文感知 XR 界面的基准测试框架。它把 XR 应用表示为功能切面（functional facets）构成的连通图，每个切面……（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30466v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Everyday Extended Reality (XR) systems aim to provide context-aware access to the right functionalities at the right time and place, with minimal manual reconfiguration as users switch context. Yet these interfaces are hard to evaluate: current prototyping and user-study workflows offer no systematic, repeatable way to compare adaptation methods across users and scenarios. We present ContextXR, a novel benchmarking framework for context-aware XR interfaces. ContextXR represents an XR application as a connected graph of functional facets, each a…
items.why_zh: 它为上下文感知 XR 界面提供了可复现的评测方法，填补了该领域缺乏系统基准的空白。
items.why_en: It offers a reproducible evaluation method for context-aware XR interfaces, filling a gap in systematic benchmarking.

items.title_zh: 打破同质化：为创意型 LLM 输出多样化人设集合
items.title_en: Breaking Homogeneity: Diversifying Persona Sets for Creative LLM Outputs
items.summary_zh: 语言模型在面对开放式任务时往往给出高度同质的回答，而这种同质化可能催生“群体思维”——创意向单一、甚至次优的方向收敛。该论文将“人设多样化”形式化为一个集合级条件控制问题，并研究两个相互正交的设计维度：是“选择”已有的人设还是“生成”新的人设，以及追求“空间填充式”覆盖还是“前沿探索式”多样性。作者用四种方法实例化了这一设计空间，涵盖覆盖度与离散度子集选择、均匀覆盖采样以及进化式人设生成等。该工作为提升 LLM 输出的创意多样性提供了可比较的方法框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30492v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language models often produce homogeneous responses to open-ended tasks; such homogeneity can spawn groupthink-the convergence of ideas toward a singular and potentially suboptimal decision. We formulate persona diversification as a set-level conditioning problem and study two orthogonal design choices: selecting versus generating personas, and space-filling versus frontier-seeking diversity. We instantiate this design space with four methods spanning coverage and dispersion subset selections, uniform-coverage sampling, and evolutionary persona…
items.why_zh: 它把“让模型更有创意”从提示技巧升级为可系统研究的集合级条件控制问题。
items.why_en: It turns creative-diversity prompting into a systematically studiable set-level conditioning problem.

items.title_zh: 搜索之后才是难点：面向知识整合、组织与呈现的 Web Agent 基准
items.title_en: The Hard Part Comes After Search: Benchmarking Web Agents on Synthesizing, Organizing, and Displaying Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 现有计算机使用（computer-use）智能体基准并未充分评估智能体作为“助手”的能力：一个有用的助手需要在复杂的多步流程中跨源检索信息，将其综合成文档、演示文稿、表格等成果物，并操作软件界面产出连贯的最终成品。这类工作流要求推理与综合能力、复杂任务的分解能力，以及视觉与空间理解能力。为此，作者提出 KNOWS——一个面向开放式、复杂、基于浏览器的任务的基准，用以系统研究智能体在这类工作流中的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30604v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks do not fully evaluate agents acting as assistants. A useful assistant retrieves information across complex, multi-step workflows, synthesizes it into artifacts (documents, presentations, spreadsheets), and navigates program interfaces to produce a coherent final product. Such workflows demand reasoning and synthesis, decomposition of complex tasks, as well as visual and spatial understanding. To study agents on workflows like these, we introduce KNOWS, a benchmark of open-ended, complex, browser-based task…
items.why_zh: 它把评测重点从“找信息”推进到更贴近真实助理工作的“综合、组织与呈现”能力。
items.why_en: It moves agent evaluation beyond information retrieval to the synthesis, organization and presentation skills real assistants need.

items.title_zh: 识别、归类与解释 AI 生成代码中偏见的框架
items.title_en: A Framework for Identifying, Categorizing, and Explaining Bias in AI-Generated Code
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型被整合进软件开发流程，人们开始担忧 AI 生成代码中可能存在的无意偏见。尽管已有证据表明这类偏见确实存在，但系统性地识别、归类和解释它们的研究仍然有限。本研究考察 AI 生成代码中的偏见，并评估 LLM 能否通过一个由分类体系（taxonomy）驱动的框架可靠地识别和解释这些偏见。作者扩展了已有的含偏见 AI 生成 Python 代码数据集，并人工为代码片段标注偏见类别。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30642v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become integrated into software development workflows, concerns regarding unintentional biases in AI-generated code. Although evidence suggests these biases exist, limited research has systematically identified, categorized, and explained them. This study investigates bias in AI-generated code and evaluates whether LLMs can reliably identify and explain it through a taxonomy-driven framework. We extended an existing dataset of biased AI-generated Python code and manually annotated snippets with bias categories an…
items.why_zh: 它试图为 AI 生成代码中的偏见建立可复用的分类与解释框架，而非停留在零散案例。
items.why_en: It aims to give AI-generated code bias a reusable taxonomy and explanation framework rather than anecdotal case studies.

items.title_zh: 交互式智能体中的因果保留：界面分解与选择性适应
items.title_en: Causal Retention in Interactive Agents: Interface Factorization and Selective Adaptation
items.summary_zh: 智能体的任务表现并不必然决定它保留了哪种干预机制。该研究考察“因果保留”：一个冻结的学习状态能否回答一个独立于训练过程而固定的机制探测映射，该映射涵盖动作、上下文、直接目标、价值与延迟等维度。对于有限的结构因果模型类，最优探测误差是一个贝叶斯决策风险；当且仅当每个“学习界面”纤维都落在同一个“探测答案”纤维之内时，该误差才会消失，而任何通过对该界面做后处理得到的状态都继承同样的下界。作者还提及后验覆盖（posterior-cove…）等后续分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30650v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Task performance need not determine which intervention mechanism an agent retains. We study causal retention: whether a frozen learned state answers a mechanism-probe map fixed independently of training, including action, context, direct target, value, and delay. For finite structural causal model classes, the optimal probe error is a Bayes decision risk. It vanishes exactly when every learning-interface fiber lies within one probe-answer fiber; any state obtained by post-processing that interface inherits the same lower bound. A posterior-cove…
items.why_zh: 它提出了一个可理论刻画的“因果保留”视角，用于判断智能体究竟保留了什么机制。
items.why_en: It offers a theoretically grounded notion of causal retention for judging what mechanism an agent actually preserves.

items.title_zh: SAGE：以频率均衡实现源锚定引导的层级 RGB-T 配准与融合
items.title_en: SAGE: Source-Anchored Guidance via Frequency Equalization for Hierarchical RGB-T Alignment and Fusion
items.summary_zh: 空间失配与跨模态差异往往会在 RGB-T 融合中造成鬼影、结构模糊和内容失衡。现有方法通常将外观适配、几何对齐与信息融合彼此解耦，限制了各阶段之间的依赖传播。为此，作者提出 SAGE——一个统一框架，将频率均衡、层级对齐与子带融合整合在一起。SAGE 采用可逆联合编码与源锚定引导（source-anchored guidance），以缓解上述问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30703v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spatial misregistration and cross-modal discrepancies often cause ghosting, structural blurring, and content imbalance in RGB-T fusion. Existing methods typically decouple appearance adaptation, geometric alignment, and information fusion, limiting dependency propagation across stages. We propose Source-Anchored Guidance via Frequency Equalization for Hierarchical RGB-T Alignment and Fusion (SAGE), a unified framework integrating frequency equalization, hierarchical alignment, and subband fusion. SAGE employs invertible joint encoding and sourc…
items.why_zh: 它把 RGB-T 融合中通常被拆开的对齐与融合步骤统一起来，减少跨阶段信息损失。
items.why_en: It unifies alignment and fusion stages in RGB-T that are usually decoupled, reducing cross-stage information loss.

items.title_zh: 结合通用与领域特定预训练任务用于脑部 MR 图像分割
items.title_en: Combining General and Domain-Specific Pretext Tasks for Brain MR Image Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 医学图像分析的一大挑战是特定人群与疾病的大规模标注数据稀缺。由于深度学习模型高度依赖标注数据，需要有效的迁移学习策略来降低对人工标注的依赖。自监督学习通过从大规模无标注医学影像数据中学习可迁移的特征表示，已成为构建基础模型的一条有前景的路径。本研究以体素级大脑年龄预测（voxel-level brain age prediction）为切入点，探讨如何将通用预训练任务与领域特定预训练任务结合，以服务脑部 MR 图像分割。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30708v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A key challenge in medical image analysis is the scarcity of large annotated datasets for specific populations and diseases. As deep learning models rely heavily on labeled data, effective transfer learning strategies are needed to reduce the dependence on manual annotations. Self-supervised learning has emerged as a promising approach for developing foundation models by enabling the learning of transferable feature representations from large-scale unlabeled medical imaging datasets. In this study, we investigate voxel-level brain age predictio…
items.why_zh: 它探索如何用自监督预训练减少医学影像分割对昂贵人工标注的依赖。
items.why_en: It explores self-supervised pretraining to reduce medical image segmentation's reliance on costly manual annotation.

items.title_zh: VLALight：面向紧急事件感知交通信号控制的轻量视觉-语言-动作模型
items.title_en: VLALight: Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Models for Emergency-Aware Traffic Signal Control
items.summary_zh: 交通信号控制（TSC）对缓解城市拥堵至关重要。近期视觉-语言模型（VLM）的进展让路口场景得以被更丰富地解读，为具备视觉上下文感知的交通信号控制带来新机会。然而，模块间松耦合与反复的信息转换会造成细粒度视觉细节丢失，而串行推理又带来显著延迟。为解决这些问题，作者提出 VLALight——一个轻量的端到端视觉-语言-动作框架，可直接完成映射，并面向紧急事件感知的交通信号控制场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30709v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for mitigating urban congestion. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) enable richer interpretation of intersection scenes, opening new opportunities for visual-context-aware TSC. However, the loose coupling and repeated information conversion between modules can lead to the loss of fine-grained visual details, while sequential inference introduces substantial latency. To address these limitations, we propose VLALight, a lightweight end-to-end vision-language-action framework that directly ma…
items.why_zh: 它试图用端到端轻量 VLA 架构同时解决精度损失与推理延迟两大痛点。
items.why_en: It tackles both detail loss and inference latency with a lightweight end-to-end VLA architecture.

items.title_zh: NavGen：以视觉生成模型作为具身 3D 导航的可扩展数据引擎
items.title_en: NavGen: Visual Generative Models as a Scalable Data Engine for Embodied 3D Navigation
items.summary_zh: 通用机器人模型日益依赖大规模、多样化的数据集。但在具身 3D 导航领域，现有数据来源面临一个根本性权衡：仿真数据可以大规模生成，却常存在视觉上的“仿真到现实”差距；真实飞行数据能提供逼真的观测，但采集成本高昂。本文研究另一条路径——把高保真视觉生成模型作为具身 3D 导航的可扩展数据引擎。作者提出 NavGen，一个文本到视频的数据生成流水线，用于产出导航训练所需的数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30770v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: General-purpose robot models increasingly rely on large and diverse datasets. For embodied 3D navigation, however, existing data sources face a fundamental trade-off: simulated data can be generated at scale but often suffer from the visual sim-to-real gap, whereas real-world flight data provide realistic observations but are costly to collect. This paper studies another direction: the use of high-fidelity visual generative models as scalable data engines for embodied 3D navigation. We introduce NavGen, a text-to-video data generation pipeline…
items.why_zh: 它提出用生成模型绕开仿真与真实数据之间的权衡，为具身导航提供可扩展数据来源。
items.why_en: It proposes using generative models to bypass the sim-to-real trade-off and provide scalable data for embodied navigation.

items.title_zh: 从 AI 助手到自主智能体：嵌入式软件企业迈向 AI 优先组织的路线图
items.title_en: Developing a Roadmap to an AI-first Organization: A Case Study in Embedded Software Development
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文以一家大型嵌入式系统公司为案例，研究其向“AI 优先组织”转型的过程。作者指出，AI 智能体正推动软件工程从“AI 作为助手”走向能够自主规划、执行和评估开发任务的系统。对嵌入式软件组织而言，这一转变尤为关键，因为该领域对质量、可追溯性、验证和长期可维护性有严格要求。研究采用混合方法展开案例分析，旨在为同类企业制定转型路线图提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30863v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The emergence of AI agents is expected to reshape software engineering by moving beyond AI as assistants towards systems capable of planning, executing, and evaluating development tasks with increasing autonomy. This transition is particularly significant for embedded software organizations, where strict requirements for quality, traceability, verification, and long-term maintainability often apply. This paper presents a case study of a large embedded systems company and its transition toward becoming an AI-first organization. Through a mixed m…
items.why_zh: 它把“AI 智能体改造软件工程”这一趋势落到对质量与可追溯性要求最严苛的嵌入式领域，为企业转型提供可操作的路线图思路。
items.why_en: It grounds the AI-agent-driven transformation of software engineering in embedded systems, where quality and traceability demands are strictest, offering a roadmap for organizational transition.

items.title_zh: UltraG-Bench：评估超声图像大视觉语言模型像素级证据定位的多任务基准
items.title_en: UltraG-Bench: A Multi-task Benchmark for assessing Large Vision-Language Models on Pixel-level Evidence Grounding in Ultrasound
items.summary_zh: 超声是最广泛使用的医学影像模态之一，近期大视觉语言模型在超声图像理解上表现日益增强，但它们往往无法给出与语义预测相匹配的像素级视觉证据，其细粒度定位能力也尚不明确。为此研究者提出 UltraG-Bench，这是一个用于评估超声像素级证据定位的大规模多任务基准，基于对 40 个公开超声数据集的标注构建。该基准旨在系统检验模型“说得出、也指得准”的能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30928v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultrasound is one of the most widely used medical imaging modalities, and recent large vision-language models(VLMs) have shown increasing capabilities in ultrasound image understanding. However, these models fail to provide pixel-level visual evidence aligned with their semantic predictions, and their fine-grained grounding capability in ultrasound remains largely unclear. We introduce UltraG-Bench, a large-scale multi-task benchmark for evaluating pixel-level evidence grounding in ultrasound. UltraG-Bench is built by annotating 40 public ultra…
items.why_zh: 医疗影像中的模型若不能指出像素级证据，临床可信度存疑，该基准为超声视觉语言模型的可解释性与可靠性提供了统一评测标准。
items.why_en: Without pixel-level evidence, medical VLM predictions are hard to trust clinically; this benchmark provides a unified way to measure grounding reliability in ultrasound.

items.title_zh: MVVBench：面向视觉语言模型多视角视频（4D）推理的基准
items.title_en: MVVBench: Benchmarking 4D Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 多视角视频理解要求模型整合来自多个（常常互不重叠）摄像头流的空间与时间证据：追踪实体在不同视角间的转移、对齐跨时间的事件，并推理潜在的 4D 连续性，而非依赖任何单一可见画面。为此研究者提出 MVVBench，一个基于真实世界多摄像头数据集构建的多视角视频推理基准。其问题经过精心设计，在视角与时间两个维度上都具备“单目歧义性”，即任何单一视角都无法作答。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30952v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-view video understanding requires integrating spatial and temporal evidence across multiple, often non-overlapping camera streams: tracking entities as they transition between viewpoints, aligning events across time, and reasoning about latent 4D continuity rather than any single visible frame. We introduce MVVBench, a benchmark for multi-view video reasoning built from real world multi camera datasets. Questions are curated to be monocular-ambiguous along both the view and the temporal axis: each question is unanswerable from any single…
items.why_zh: 现有视频基准多停留在单视角，MVVBench 用“单目歧义”设计逼出模型真正的跨视角 4D 时空推理能力。
items.why_en: Most video benchmarks remain single-view; MVVBench's monocular-ambiguous design forces models to demonstrate genuine cross-view 4D spatiotemporal reasoning.

items.title_zh: 均匀离散扩散模型真的需要时间条件吗？
items.title_en: Does Uniform Discrete Diffusion Need Time?
items.summary_zh: 均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）通常显式使用时间条件，但作者发现这一做法在实践中往往并非必要。论文首先表明，群体最优的 UDM 预测器一般确实依赖时间，因为时间决定了模型应在多大程度上信任已观察到的上下文；随后又证明，在语言等有限数据场景下这种依赖可能变得可以忽略——当被破坏的训练序列仍然远比竞争序列更接近其原始干净序列时，经验最优解对时间的敏感度大幅下降。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Uniform discrete diffusion models (UDMs) commonly use explicit time conditioning, but we find that it can often be unnecessary in practice. In this paper, we first show that the population-optimal UDM predictor generally depends on time: time controls how much the model should trust the observed context. We then show that this dependence can become negligible in finite-data settings relevant to language. When a corrupted training sequence remains much closer to its original clean sequence than to competing training sequences, the empirical-opti…
items.why_zh: 它挑战了离散扩散模型的常规设计假设，若时间条件可省略，模型结构可被简化，从而降低训练与推理开销。
items.why_en: It challenges a standard design assumption in discrete diffusion; if time conditioning can be dropped, models can be simplified, cutting training and inference cost.

items.title_zh: FARE：用取证接受域估计揪出“调包”式图像生成器
items.title_en: FARE: Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation for Catching Bait-and-Switch Image Generators
items.summary_zh: 现代 AI 图像生成器越来越多地以不透明 API 形式部署，客户可以调用服务，却无法查看模型权重或架构。由此产生一个现实问题：服务商可能用某个生成器通过治理认证，之后却悄悄换成更便宜、质量更低的模型对外提供服务，从而损害公众信任，在高风险领域甚至危及安全。论文研究部署时的完整性审计问题，提出 FARE（取证接受域估计）方法：先为通过认证的生成器建立“登记”，再据此判断部署中的模型是否被替换。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30982v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern AI image generators are increasingly deployed as opaque APIs, where customers can query the deployed service, but cannot inspect model weights or architecture. This creates a practical challenge: a provider may pass governance certification with one generator and later silently switch to a cheaper and lower-quality one for deployment, compromising public trust or even safety in high-stakes domains. We study integrity auditing at deployment time and propose FARE (Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation). A certified generator is enrolled by…
items.why_zh: 当生成模型只能通过 API 访问时，认证与合规可能名不副实，FARE 提供了在部署阶段验证“所审即所用”的取证手段。
items.why_en: When generators are only reachable via APIs, certification can be hollowed out; FARE offers a forensic way to verify at deployment that the audited model is the one actually serving.

items.title_zh: G²PTQ：用广义梯度补偿改进大语言模型训练后量化
items.title_en: G$^2$PTQ: Improving LLM Post-Training Quantization with Generalized Gradient Compensation
items.summary_zh: 训练后量化（PTQ）是在不重新训练的前提下降低大语言模型内存与计算开销的实用方法，其中基于 GPTQ 的方法已成为事实标准，但存在两方面互补的缺陷：局部、逐层目标的方法缺乏全局监督；而具备全局目标的方法在开始时固定 Hessian 估计并忽略一阶梯度，导致随着量化推进其指导逐渐失效。论文提出 G²PTQ，一个统一的 PTQ 框架，通过广义梯度补偿来缓解上述问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31009v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a practical approach to reducing the memory and computational footprint of large language models (LLMs) without retraining. GPTQ-based methods have become the de facto standard, yet they suffer from two complementary limitations. Methods with local, layer-wise objectives lack global supervision; while methods with global objectives fix their Hessian estimates at the start and ignore first-order gradients, so their guidance grows stale as quantization proceeds. This paper presents G$^2$PTQ, a unified PTQ frame…
items.why_zh: 量化是 LLM 落地的关键成本手段，G²PTQ 通过引入持续更新的梯度与全局监督，有望在同等位宽下提升模型质量。
items.why_en: Quantization is central to LLM deployment economics; G²PTQ's continuously updated gradients and global supervision may improve quality at the same bit width.

items.title_zh: DynBranch：为动态智能体式 LLM 服务提供投机式子图复用
items.title_en: DynBranch: Speculative Subgraph Reuse for Dynamic Agentic LLM Serving
items.summary_zh: 智能体式 LLM 工作流在运行时才决定自己的执行路径，下游计算虽然可能可预测、甚至此前已经运行过，但在模型或用户解决分支之前无法开始，作者将这种串行等待称为“分支解析屏障”。仅靠缓存无法隐藏该屏障，因为用于识别可复用结果的键在屏障解除前并不确定。论文提出 DynBranch，让尚未解决的分支在解析前就可被寻址，其稳定坐标允许候选子图在分支解析期间并行执行，并复用已完成的子图。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31047v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic LLM workflows decide their execution paths at runtime. Downstream computation may be predictable, or may have run before, yet it cannot begin until the model or the user resolves the branch. We call this serialization the branch-resolution barrier. Caching alone does not hide it: the key that identifies a reusable result is not known until then. In this paper, we propose DynBranch, which makes an unresolved branch addressable before it resolves. Its stable coordinate lets candidate subgraphs run during resolution and completed subgraph…
items.why_zh: 它针对智能体服务中特有的串行等待瓶颈，用投机执行的思路把推理延迟藏起来，对智能体系统吞吐与响应速度有直接价值。
items.why_en: It targets a serialization bottleneck unique to agentic serving, hiding latency through speculative execution — directly valuable for agent throughput and responsiveness.

items.title_zh: 面向医学图像分析的量子扩散模型
items.title_en: Quantum Diffusion Models for Medical Image Analysis
items.summary_zh: 量子机器学习是一个新兴研究方向，旨在利用叠加、纠缠和干涉等量子力学原理构建机器学习方法。在此背景下，作者提出一种可扩展的混合量子扩散模型，并评估其在医学图像分析中的应用。具体而言，该方法基于离散时间量子行走算法，并在真实量子设备上运行，用以建模扩散模型的前向动力学；对于扩散模型的反向步骤，作者也进行了设计与评估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31070v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum Machine Learning is a novel field of research aimed at devising machine learning approaches exploiting principles of quantum mechanics, such as superposition, entanglement and interference. In this context, we present a scalable hybrid Quantum Diffusion Model, and evaluate its use for medical image analysis. Specifically, our method is based on a Discrete-Time Quantum Walk algorithm, executed on a real quantum device, to model the forward dynamics of the diffusion model. For the backward step of the diffusion model, we devise and evalua…
items.why_zh: 它把量子计算与扩散生成模型结合并落到真实量子硬件与医学影像任务上，是探索量子机器学习实用价值的一步。
items.why_en: It combines quantum computing with diffusion generative models on real quantum hardware for medical imaging, probing the practical value of quantum machine learning.

items.title_zh: DepthEvidence：在多模态语言模型中统一度量深度预测与几何推理
items.title_en: DepthEvidence: Unifying Metric Depth Prediction and Geometric Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出 DepthEvidence，一个 4B 规模的多模态模型，尝试把带度量约束的空间推理与语言生成打通：模型用自身预测的稠密度量深度作为“以物体为锚点”的证据来支撑语言输出。方法上包含一个以相机条件为输入的解码器，利用多尺度视觉特征与高分辨率 RGB 精修来预测全分辨率度量深度；再通过稠密到语言的接口，把预测深度与解码器特征转换为对齐物体的连续几何 token，供语言推理使用。其目标是让模型在做语言推理时保留几何测量的数值内容，从而在空间推理任务中更准确、更可解释。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spatial reasoning with metric constraints requires linking objects to geometric measurements and preserving their numerical content during language reasoning. We present DepthEvidence, a 4B model that uses its own dense metric predictions as object-grounded evidence for language generation. A camera-conditioned decoder predicts full-resolution metric depth using multi-scale visual features and high-resolution RGB refinement. A dense-to-language interface converts predicted depths and decoder features into object-aligned continuous geometry toke…
items.why_zh: 它试图解决多模态模型在语言推理中丢失数值与几何精度的问题，把度量深度预测直接变成语言生成的证据。
items.why_en: It addresses the loss of numerical and geometric precision in multimodal language reasoning by turning metric depth predictions into evidence for generation.

items.title_zh: 基于 Fisher 信息几何的贝叶斯优化：梯度上界与信赖域方法
items.title_en: Bayesian Optimization with Fisher Information Geometry: Gradient Bounds and Trust-Region Methods
items.summary_zh: 论文从信息几何的视角重新审视贝叶斯优化（BO）：通过代理后验映射把 Fisher 信息度量拉回到输入空间，得到一个局部敏感度张量，并由此导出可重参数化采集函数梯度的上界。这一视角解释了高维 BO 中梯度消失的现象，也为 RAASP、按维度缩放长度尺度等启发式做法提供了统一解释。在此分析基础上，作者提出 FITR——一种基于信赖域的贝叶斯优化方法，用以在高维场景下更稳健地选择候选点。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31107v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study Bayesian optimization (BO) through the lens of information geometry. Pulling back the Fisher information metric through the surrogate posterior map yields a local sensitivity tensor on the input space, which leads to an upper bound on the gradient of reparameterizable acquisition functions. This view explains vanishing-gradient behavior in high-dimensional BO and provides a common interpretation of heuristics such as RAASP and dimension-scaled lengthscales. Building on this analysis, we propose FITR, a trust-region-based BO method that…
items.why_zh: 它用信息几何为高维贝叶斯优化的梯度消失与常见启发式提供了统一理论解释，并据此设计了新算法。
items.why_en: It offers a unified information-geometric explanation for vanishing gradients and common heuristics in high-dimensional Bayesian optimization, and builds a new algorithm on it.

items.title_zh: 从捷径学习到离散神经插入排序
items.title_en: From Shortcut Learning to Discrete Neural Insertion Sort
items.summary_zh: 神经算法推理希望神经网络能遵循已知算法，并在超出训练规模的输入上泛化，但正确的最终输出与中间监督未必说明模型真的在执行目标算法。作者以插入排序为研究对象，分析 CLRS30 基线 NAR 模型后发现：提示目标（hint objective）实际上优化得很弱，提示准确率持续偏低；而且在真正参照执行之前，许多中间表示就已经可以被解码成有序序列，说明模型可能走了捷径。论文据此转向离散化的神经插入排序思路，关注模型是否真正按算法的离散步骤执行。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31114v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural algorithmic reasoning aims to train neural networks to follow known algorithms and generalize beyond the input sizes seen during training. However, correct final outputs and intermediate supervision do not necessarily show that a model follows the intended execution. We study this problem using insertion sort. Our analysis of the CLRS30 baseline NAR shows that the hint objective is weakly optimized and that hint accuracy remains low. Moreover, many intermediate representations can already be decoded into sorted sequences before the refer…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了神经算法推理评测中的“捷径学习”陷阱，提醒不能仅凭输出正确就断定模型学会了算法。
items.why_en: It exposes shortcut learning in neural algorithmic reasoning, showing that correct outputs alone do not prove a model has learned the intended algorithm.

items.title_zh: JevAdvBench：面向可校准决策强化学习模型的基准与黑盒攻击
items.title_en: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
items.summary_zh: 用“可校准决策强化学习”（RLCD）训练的模型（如 Jev）会针对输入状态回答一个有类型的问题，输出概率、选择或分数，随后由软件直接据此行动，而不经人工阅读。这类模型的鲁棒性此前未被测量：现有对抗基准评估的是模型生成或执行的内容，而类型化模型本身不生成内容，即便被操纵也仍会返回格式良好的答案。测量本身也很困难，因为相同请求可能返回不同答案，且多数可用标签并不完备。为此，论文提出 JevAdvBench 基准及相应黑盒攻击方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31142v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Models trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), such as Jev, answer a typed question about an input, the state, with a probability, a choice, or a score, and software acts on the answer without a person reading it. Their robustness has not been measured: adversarial benchmarks score what a model generates or executes, whereas a typed model generates nothing and returns a well-formed answer even when manipulated. Measurement is also hard, because identical requests can return different answers, most available labels c…
items.why_zh: 自动化决策模型的输出会被软件直接执行，其对抗鲁棒性关乎真实系统安全，而此前缺乏针对性评测手段。
items.why_en: Outputs of automated decision models are acted on directly by software, so their adversarial robustness matters for real systems—yet no tailored benchmark existed.

items.title_zh: FedHisto-PAST：面向跨站点肺组织病理分类的参数高效染色感知联邦学习
items.title_en: FedHisto-PAST: Parameter-Efficient Stain-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Site Lung Histopathology Classification
items.summary_zh: 跨站点肺组织病理分类需要同时应对染色差异、客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）、类别缺失，以及适配大型病理编码器的高昂成本。该研究评估了 FedHisto-PAST v2 在腺癌（ACA）、正常与鳞状细胞癌（SCC）三分类任务上的表现。方法结合了冻结的 HIBOU-B 基础模型与参数高效适配、染色条件下的配对视图预测与特征一致性、可靠性感知的原型学习，以及自适应联邦聚合。实验用于验证其在上述真实约束下的分类效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31150v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cross-site lung histopathology classification must account for stain variation, non-IID client data, missing classes, and the cost of adapting large pathology encoders. This study evaluates FedHisto-PAST v2 for three-way classification of adenocarcinoma (ACA), Normal, and squamous cell carcinoma (SCC). FedHisto-PAST v2 combines a frozen HIBOU-B foundation model with parameter-efficient adaptation, stain-conditioned paired-view prediction and feature consistency, reliability-aware prototype learning, and adaptive federated aggregation. Experimen…
items.why_zh: 它把参数高效适配、染色鲁棒性与联邦学习结合，为多中心病理数据难以共享的现实场景提供可行方案。
items.why_en: It combines parameter-efficient adaptation, stain robustness, and federated learning to make multi-site pathology training feasible without sharing data.

items.title_zh: 域偏移下以后训练量化模型的选择：以教师为锚
items.title_en: Teacher-Anchored Selection of Post-Training Quantized Models under Domain Shift
items.summary_zh: 对训练好的模型做压缩会得到一族可部署候选，而在域偏移下，压缩得最狠的版本未必最适合部署。论文研究在候选模型与教师模型固定、目标域标签缺失或稀缺的条件下如何做选择。在两个无标签场景的发现中，其一是“最小教师失真”几乎表现为恒定规则：每次运行都会选出同样的八比特、逐通道、未裁剪配置，但该配置并不能最小化目标域上的经验交叉熵；其二是既有估计器在过度压缩等情形下表现分化明显。研究据此讨论如何在缺乏标签时更可靠地挑选量化模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Compressing a trained model yields a family of deployment candidates, and under domain shift the most compressed one need not be the one to deploy. We study selection over such a family, with candidates and teacher fixed and target labels absent or scarce. Two findings organize the label-free case. Minimum teacher distortion behaves almost as a constant rule, selecting the same eight-bit, per-channel, unclipped configuration in every run, which does not minimize empirical target cross-entropy. Established estimators divide sharply: in the overc…
items.why_zh: 它指出常用的“最小教师失真”选择准则在域偏移下可能失效，提醒部署量化模型时不能只看压缩率或单一指标。
items.why_en: It shows the common minimum-teacher-distortion rule can fail under domain shift, warning against selecting quantized models by compression rate or a single metric.
